title: Amazon Catalog Maintenance Assistant
description:
APPLY ONLY IF YOU QUALIFY AS AN EXPERT, NOT A BEGINNER.



About the role



We need someone who can keep a large Amazon catalog clean and fix what breaks, every day, without being told twice.

We are a US-based Amazon agency. Our clients run several hundred SKUs across Seller Central and Vendor Central, in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil. When a listing suppresses, a variation breaks, or a new SKU needs to go live, you are the person who handles it.



This is a hands-on catalog seat, not a strategy seat. You will be in flat files, case logs and listing backends most of the day. If that sounds tedious, this is not the job. If you find a broken parentage satisfying to fix, keep reading.

What you'll be doing



Listing troubleshooting

• Diagnose and fix suppressed, stranded, and inactive listings

• Resolve flat file errors and failed uploads

• Fix incorrect or missing detail page attributes

• Correct browse nodes and category misplacement

• Investigate and fix detail page content that gets overwritten



Variation and parentage work

• Create parent-child variations with the correct variation theme

• Add children to existing live parents without wiping parent data

• Remove a single child from a variation family without breaking the rest

• Split, rebuild, and re-parent broken variation families

• Preserve reviews and rank when restructuring



Listing merges and duplicates

• Merge duplicate ASINs into a single detail page

• Identify and resolve duplicate listings created by catalog conflicts

• Handle GTIN, UPC, and EAN corrections



New listing creation

• Build new listings from supplier data and spec sheets

• Bulk upload via flat files for multi-SKU launches

• Create and maintain listings across the US, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil marketplaces

• Set up backend attributes, search terms, and compliance fields once you are trained on our standard



Case and escalation management

• Open, track, and escalate Seller Support cases to resolution

• Write clear, specific case notes that get results on the first reply

• Follow up on open cases daily rather than letting them sit



Catalog audits and maintenance

• Run routine audits for data accuracy across the catalog

• Monitor account health and flag risks before they become suspensions

• Track inventory status and flag stranded or at-risk SKUs

• Maintain SKU records and documentation in 



Reporting

• Daily end-of-shift summary of what was completed, what is pending, what is blocked

• Flag anything you cannot resolve rather than guessing or letting it sit



Vendor Central

Our largest account is on Vendor Central, so a meaningful share of your day will be there.

Vendor Central experience is preferred but not required. If you are strong on Seller Central and have never touched VC, say so honestly in your application. We will teach it. What we will not do is train someone who claims VC experience they do not have, so be straight about where you are starting from.



On the VC side you would be working with:

• Item setup and catalog updates through Vendor Central

• Detail page and content updates

• Opening and escalating VC cases

Chargebacks, shortage claims, and purchase order issues sit with someone else for now. We may train you on them down the road.



Requirements



Experience

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on Amazon catalog work, minimum. Not 3 to 5 years adjacent to Amazon, and not years spent managing people who did the work

• Seller Central required

• Vendor Central preferred, but we will teach it



Hard skills

• Flat files: you know the difference between Update and PartialUpdate and what happens when you use the wrong one

• Parent-child variation management, including surgical changes to a live family

• Seller Support case handling and escalation

• Suppressed, stranded, and inactive listing resolution

• Image and A+ Content upload

• Excel and Google Sheets at a working level (filtering, lookups, cleaning supplier data for bulk uploads)

How you work

• You escalate when you are unsure instead of guessing on a live listing

• You tell us when something is broken, including when you broke it. You stay calm when a listing goes down on a deadline

• Fluent English, written and spoken. You write clearly enough that a Seller Support case or client-facing report needs light editing, not a rewrite



Logistics

• Reliable computer and backup internet

• Able to work a fixed shift, overnight if you are in Asia

• Comfortable with time tracking and an NDA



Nice to have

None of these are dealbreakers, but they move you up the list:

• Helium 10, DataDive, or similar keyword and listing tools

• Brand Registry work: brand name changes, trademark conflicts, merge issues

• Ungating and category approvals

• Account reinstatement and Plan of Action writing

• FBA shipment plan creation and reimbursement claims

• Experience with non-US Amazon marketplaces (Canada, Mexico, Brazil)

• 
, Asana, or similar project tracking



How we work



Schedule

Full time, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM US Eastern (8:00 PM to 4:00 AM Philippine time) if needed more on occasion we will let you know



Exclusivity

 No side accounts, no stacked contracts



Engagement

Independent contractor. W-8BEN required. NDA before account access



Compensation

Based on experience. Reviewed at six months, with a check-in around month four



Tools

Hubstaff, 
, Helium 10, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams



Location

Remote. Philippines preferred



You will work across more than one account. One takes the bulk of the day and the other is lighter. We like our people seeing more than one brand because you learn faster and the work stays interesting.



Before you apply

Read this part carefully.

If you do not have the hands-on experience described above, please do not apply. We are not looking for someone to train from zero, and we are not interested in finding out on a call that the resume was optimistic.

If you have genuinely done the work, you will enjoy this interview. Apply.



APPLY ONLY IF YOU QUALIFY AS AN EXPERT, NOT A BEGINNER.

You will work closely with ownership, Dispatch, and our U.S. Fleet & On-Site Operations Coordinator. You will also participate in calls with Amazon concerning delivery performance, scorecards, and corrective actions.



## Responsibilities



### Walker onboarding and welcome calls



- Lead welcome calls and manage new walkers’ transition through onboarding, orientation, training, and handoff to operations.

- Guide employees through Paycom setup, ORE, and other required onboarding steps.

- Explain relevant systems and procedures during onboarding, including Baton, Walker DVIC, and Geotab.

- Track outstanding requirements, coordinate handoffs, and verify completion.

- Maintain onboarding checklists, call scripts, instructions, and employee records.



### Performance calls and employee support



- Prepare for and lead weekly employee performance calls.

- Join calls with Amazon related to performance, scorecards, operational concerns, and corrective actions.

- Prepare supporting information, document action items, and follow through on commitments from those calls.

- Document coaching, employee concerns, performance disputes, and follow-up actions.

- Prepare disciplinary documentation and coordinate management-approved actions.

- Help resolve onboarding, Paycom, and pay-related questions with the appropriate team member.



### Delivery investigations and Amazon disputes



- Investigate delivery issues, identify root causes, and organize supporting evidence.

- Prepare and submit logistics and delivery-associate scorecard disputes.

- Submit Amazon support tickets and track responses, deadlines, escalations, and outcomes.

- Coordinate corrective actions with Dispatch and the fleet team.

- Maintain clear case records through resolution.



### Injury reporting and claims coordination



- Coordinate workers’ compensation paperwork, employee injury reports, and administrative follow-up on vehicle a
.

- Collect required information and route documents to designated contacts.

- Track deadlines, missing information, and next actions.

- Maintain confidential records and escalate urgent matters promptly.



### Documentation, reporting, and special projects



- Maintain procedures, templates, system references, and contact lists.

- Prepare weekly summaries of onboarding, performance follow-up, disputes, employee cases, and overdue actions.

- Complete occasional special projects, including audits, process improvements, and system transitions.



## Qualifications



- At least two years of relevant experience in people operations, employee support, compliance coordination, or logistics administration.

- Experience supporting U.S. employees or U.S. business operations.

- Excellent spoken and written English and confidence leading employee calls and participating in business meetings.

- Strong investigation, spreadsheet, documentation, and follow-up skills.

- Sound judgment when handling confidential information.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and a quiet environment for calls.

- Availability to work consistent U.S. Eastern hours and attend scheduled Amazon performance calls.

- Paycom, Amazon DSP, delivery operations, scorecard dispute, or workers’ compensation experience is preferred.



## How to apply



Submit your résumé and brief answers to these questions:



1. What experience do you have supporting U.S. employees or delivery operations?

2. Describe an onboarding problem, employee concern, or operational dispute you helped resolve.

3. Which HR, payroll, and logistics systems have you used?

4. Describe your experience participating in client or operational performance calls.

5. Can you consistently work U.S. Eastern hours, including scheduled weekend coverage?

6. What is your expected hourly rate and earliest start date?



Please include a short voice introduction describing your relevant experience.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more

title: Amazon Account Specialist – Seller Central
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



We are a growing U.S.-based Amazon agency managing approximately 100 brands across a wide range of product categories. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Specialist to join our remote team and help manage the day-to-day execution of our clients' Amazon accounts.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who already understands Amazon Seller Central, can work independently, and is comfortable identifying and solving problems inside active Amazon accounts.



What You'll Do



You will work alongside Account Managers and other Amazon specialists to help manage client accounts, including:



Creating and optimizing Amazon listings

Updating titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, and A+ Content

Managing variations and parent/child relationships

Troubleshooting suppressed, stranded, inactive, and restricted listings

Opening and managing Seller Support cases through resolution

Monitoring Account Health and identifying issues that need attention

Reviewing FBA inventory and helping with replenishment recommendations

Troubleshooting FBA receiving and inventory discrepancies

Managing coupons, promotions, deals, and other Seller Central programs

Performing keyword, competitor, category, and listing research

Reviewing accounts for opportunities and problems

Coordinating tasks with advertising, inventory, catalog, and creative team members

Keeping tasks organized and updated

Following up until issues are actually resolved



For us, "done" means the change is live and correct on Amazon, not simply that a case was opened or a task was submitted.



What We're Looking For



You should have 2+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience and be comfortable navigating Seller Central without extensive training.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



Amazon Seller Central

Listing creation and optimization

Catalog troubleshooting

Variations

FBA

Inventory management

Account Health

Seller Support cases

A+ Content and Brand Registry

Promotions and coupons

Amazon reports and business data

Basic Amazon PPC knowledge



You do not need to be a dedicated PPC specialist, but you should understand concepts such as ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, Sponsored Products, keywords, bids, and search terms.



Who We're Looking For



We care as much about how you work as what you already know.



You should be:



Proactive. You notice problems and opportunities instead of waiting for someone to assign every task.

Detail-oriented. Small Amazon mistakes can have large consequences.

Resourceful. You research problems, work through Seller Support, and keep pushing until you find a solution.

Responsive. You communicate promptly and don't leave teammates or clients waiting.

Accountable. If you own something, you follow it through to completion.

Organized. You'll be working across multiple brands and priorities.

A strong written communicator. Clear English communication is important.

Comfortable with feedback. We move quickly and continuously improve our processes.

About the Role



We are a small but growing remote team, so this isn't a corporate environment where you only handle one narrow task.



You'll get exposure to many different Amazon businesses, categories, and problems. Strong performers will have opportunities to take on more account ownership and responsibility over time.



We value people who take ownership, solve problems, communicate well, and make the rest of the team better.



Schedule



This is a full-time, long-term remote position.



We offer flexibility in working hours, but you should generally be available for 1–3 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for team communication and meetings.



How to Apply



Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly in Amazon Seller Central?

What were your primary responsibilities?

Approximately how many Amazon accounts have you managed or supported?

Describe one difficult Amazon catalog, FBA, or account issue you personally solved. What was the problem, and what did you do?

Which area are you strongest in: catalog/listings, inventory/FBA, account health, PPC, or general account management?

What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



Please begin your application with the words "SELLER CENTRAL" so we know you read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the team.

title: Supply Chain Director
description:
We The Wild is a fast-growing plant care brand selling direct to consumers in Australia and the US, and through Target and Amazon. Our products are assembled from components (bottles, caps, plugs, liquids and cartons) made by suppliers in China and assembled by contract manufacturers. We work with 3PLs in Australia and the US.



The role

We’re looking for a senior supply chain leader to build and own our supply chain from end to end. You’ll design the systems, processes and planning models that run our operations, and then run them day to day.



We’re a lean team, so this role suits someone who is as comfortable building a 12-month planning model as raising a PO or chasing a forwarder. You’ll move between hands-on work and management as the business needs, with full ownership and accountability for results.



What you’ll build and own



Team: you’ll be supported by one direct report, so you’ll split your time between leading and doing.

Planning system: build and maintain the model that turns our sales forecast into assembly plans, component requirements (BOM) and purchase orders. Set the rules for safety stock, reorder points and order quantities.

Processes: create clear, repeatable processes for purchasing, receiving, stock reconciliation and supplier management, documented so they scale as we grow.

Purchasing: raise and manage POs with suppliers in China and contract manufacturers, working within lead times, MOQs, order multiples and price breaks.

Freight and logistics: d
 between sea, air and LCL, manage forwarders and 3PLs, and track landed cost per PO.

Finance: own the 12-month inventory and freight spend plan, actuals vs plan, and the cash forecast for stock.

Systems: own our inventory system (Cin7) and the accuracy of its data.

S&OP: run a monthly planning meeting with leadership, product and US operations.

Performance: set and report KPIs, including OTIF, stock availability, inventory health and supplier performance.



You must have



8+ years in supply chain, including at least 2 years as the most senior supply chain person at a growing consumer brand.

A track record of building supply chain systems and processes from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones.

Built component (BOM) planning for assembled products yourself, from forecast through to POs.

Hands-on experience with suppliers in China and international freight.

Built forward inventory spend plans for finance.

Experience managing at least one direct report.

Strong modelling in Excel or Google Sheets, and experience with an inventory or ERP system (Cin7, NetSuite, SAP or similar).

Comfortable in a lean team: you take ownership, follow through without chasing and flag problems early.

Clear written and spoken English. You’ll work directly with leadership and suppliers.

Able to work at least 6 hours a day within Sydney business hours (roughly 6am–2pm PHT).



Nice to have



Cin7 experience.

Experience with Amazon or US retail (e.g. Target).

Experience working with contract manufacturers or co-packers.



What we offer



A full-time, long-term role with real ownership of a core part of the business.

The chance to build the supply chain function as we grow.

You’re judged on results, not hours, and there’s no time tracking.

Direct access to the founder and leadership team.



How to apply

Start your application with the words “Deep Roots” so we know you’ve read this ad. We won’t review applications without them. Then include:



Your CV and a short summary of the most senior supply chain role you’ve held: company size, who you reported to, and what you were responsible for.

A short answer (3–5 sentences) to this question: “Tell us about a supply chain system or process you built from scratch. What problem did it solve, and what changed as a result?”

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.

We are a growing Construction Marketing Agency helping contractors, construction companies, and home service businesses grow through digital marketing, social media, and online solutions.



We are looking for a creative, tech-savvy, and highly motivated Virtual Assistant who is passionate about technology, artificial intelligence, video creation, and social media marketing.



We want someone who enjoys exploring new AI tools, creating engaging content, editing videos, and helping businesses build a strong online presence.



If you're creative, organized, eager to learn, and comfortable using modern digital tools, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



1. AI Tools & Automation



Use AI tools to help create content, images, videos, and marketing materials.

Utilize ChatGPT and other AI platforms to generate ideas, captions, scripts, and content.

Research and explore new AI tools that can improve productivity and marketing workflows.

Use AI to streamline repetitive tasks and improve efficiency.

Assist in creating AI-powered marketing content.



2. Video Creation & Editing



Create engaging short-form videos for social media.

Edit Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and other promotional content.

Add captions, subtitles, transitions, music, and visual effects.

Create engaging video content using existing footage, images, and AI-generated materials.

Help develop creative video ideas and content concepts.

Repurpose long-form videos into short-form content.

Ensure videos are professional, engaging, and aligned with our brand.



3. Social Media Management



Manage and maintain company and client social media accounts.

Schedule and publish posts across
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Create engaging captions, hashtags, and social media content.

Develop and organize social media content calendars.

Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement.

Help grow social media presence and brand awareness.

Research trending topics, content ideas, and relevant hashtags.

Track social media performance and prepare basic reports.



4. Graphic Design & Content Creation



Create graphics, promotional materials, and social media posts using Canva or similar tools.

Design simple marketing materials for construction and home service businesses.

Create visually appealing content that follows brand guidelines.

Assist with creating thumbnails, banners, and promotional graphics.



5. General Virtual Assistant Tasks



Organize digital files, content, and marketing materials.

Coordinate with the marketing team.

Manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.

Provide regular progress updates.

Research new marketing trends and opportunities.

Assist with other digital marketing and administrative tasks as needed.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS



Our ideal candidate should have:



Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator.

Strong knowledge of AI tools and how to use them effectively.

Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI platforms.

Video editing skills, preferably using CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Premiere Pro.

Experience managing
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Basic graphic design skills.

Excellent written English communication skills.

Good understanding of social media trends and content strategies.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Creative thinking and attention to detail.

Willingness to learn new technologies and marketing tools.

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup.

BONUS SKILLS



These skills will give you an advantage:



Experience working with US-based clients.

Experience working with digital marketing agencies.

Knowledge of the construction, roofing, remodeling, or home services industry.

Experience with AI video tools such as Runway, Kling, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with ElevenLabs, Descript, or other AI voice and video tools.

Knowledge of Meta Business Suite.

Experience with social media analytics and reporting.

Familiarity with GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms.

Experience creating content for contractors and construction businesses.

AI TOOLS WE EXPECT YOU TO KNOW



You don't need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and working with modern AI platforms.



Examples include:



ChatGPT – AI writing, research, and content ideas.

Canva – Graphic design and AI content creation.

CapCut – Video editing.

Gemini – AI research and content assistance.

Runway / Kling – AI video generation.

ElevenLabs – AI voice generation.

Descript – Video and audio editing.

Meta Business Suite – Social media management.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



Creative and full of fresh ideas.

Tech-savvy and passionate about AI.

Fast learner who enjoys exploring new tools.

Detail-oriented and organized.

Proactive and able to work with minimal supervision.

Reliable and responsible.

Open to feedback and continuous improvement.

Interested in building a long-term career with our company.



Most importantly, we want someone who doesn't just follow instructions but also brings new ideas to the table.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary based on experience.

Full-time, long-term employment opportunity.

Work-from-home arrangement.

Opportunity to work with an international marketing agency.

Training and professional development.

Opportunity to learn advanced AI and digital marketing tools.

Supportive and growth-oriented working environment.

Opportunities for career advancement as our company expands.

JOB DETAILS

Position: Tech-Savvy Virtual Assistant

Specialization: AI Tools, Video Editing & Social Media Management

Industry: Construction Marketing / Digital Marketing

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Working Hours: US Business Hours

Salary: Based on experience and qualifications

HOW TO APPLY



We'd love to know more about you!



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Tell us about yourself and your previous VA experience.

What AI tools have you used, and how do you use them?

What video editing software are you familiar with?

Which social media platforms have you managed?

Have you created Reels, TikTok videos, or YouTube Shorts before?

Can you provide samples of videos, graphics, or social media accounts you've worked on?

Have you worked with a digital marketing agency before?

What is your expected monthly salary?

What is your internet speed?

Are you available to work during US business hours?



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION:



To show us that you've carefully read the entire job description, please start your application with:



"AI IS THE FUTURE, AND I'M READY TO GROW!"



Please include links to your portfolio or previous video editing and social media work.



Applications that do not follow the application instruction may not be considered.



We're excited to find a creative, tech-savvy team member who wants to grow with our company and help us deliver outstanding digital marketing results for our clients!

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We're seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to execute our "Critical Four Marketing Tactics" and generate qualified inbound leads for Robi®, the world's first human-like AI consultant with patent-pending end to end consulting transformation technology. You'll be responsible for driving enterprise-level prospects to approach us through strategic digital campaigns targeting C-Suite executives frustrated with traditional consulting's $500B annual waste.



Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer / Founder 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Inbound Lead Generation (Primary Focus)



Execute "Critical Four Marketing Tactics" to drive qualified enterprise leads

Manage multi-channel campaigns targeting Fortune
decision makers

Optimize conversion funnels from awareness to qualified lead handoff

Generate consistent pipeline of C-Suite prospects (CEOs, CFOs, Chief Strategy Officers, Chief Revenue Officers etc.)

Digital Campaign Management



Plan and execute programmatic advertising campaigns

Design and optimize retargeting journeys for enterprise prospects

Create and manage LinkedIn, Google Ads, and other B2B advertising platforms

Develop industry-specific campaigns across 9 enterprise business functions

Landing Page & Conversion Optimization



Build and optimize conversion-focused landing pages using our templates

Implement A/B testing for headlines, messaging, and call-to-actions

Ensure mobile optimization and fast load times for enterprise prospects

Track and improve conversion rates across all marketing touchpoints

Content & Messaging Strategy



Develop compelling ad copy highlighting Robi's consultation technology

Create industry-specific messaging for different enterprise verticals

Produce thought leadership content around consulting industry disruption

Collaborate with team on "Consulting is Dead" content series

Analytics & Performance Tracking



Monitor and report on lead quality, volume, and conversion metrics

Analyze campaign performance across channels and make data-driven optimizations

Track cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, and ROI by channel

Provide weekly/monthly performance reports to leadership team

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience



3-5 years of B2B digital marketing experience, preferably enterprise software or consulting

Proven track record of generating qualified leads for high-value B2B sales cycles

Hands-on experience with programmatic advertising platforms (StackAdapt preferred)

Expertise in LinkedIn advertising, Google Ads, Meta, and retargeting campaigns

Technical Skills



Marketing Automation: HubSpot, or similar platforms

Analytics: Google Analytics, conversion tracking, attribution modeling

Design Tools: Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar for ad creation

A/B Testing: Experience with landing page and ad testing methodologies

CRM Integration: Experience connecting marketing campaigns to sales pipelines

Strategic Capabilities



Enterprise B2B Focus: Understanding of long sales cycles and complex decision-making

Account-Based Marketing: Experience targeting specific companies and personas

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with consulting, professional services, or enterprise software

Performance Marketing: ROI-focused approach with clear metrics and accountability

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Consulting Industry Experience: Understanding of Big Four, MBB, or strategy consulting

AI/Technology Marketing: Experience marketing cutting-edge technology solutions

Enterprise Sales Support: Collaboration with sales teams on lead qualification

Content Creation: Ability to create compelling thought leadership content

Marketing Automation: Advanced workflow creation and lead nurturing experience

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



Lead Generation Metrics



Monthly Qualified Leads: Target 50+ enterprise prospects per month

Lead Quality Score: Based on company size, title, and engagement level

Cost Per Lead: Optimize across channels for efficiency

Lead-to-Opportunity Conversion: Work with Client Services to track progression

Campaign Performance



Click-Through Rates: Industry-leading performance on B2B campaigns

Conversion Rates: Landing page optimization and funnel improvement

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Positive ROI across all marketing channels

Pipeline Attribution: Marketing's contribution to closed deals

Growth Objectives



Scale Lead Volume: Increase qualified leads by 25% quarter-over-quarter

Channel Diversification: Expand successful tactics across new channels

Market Penetration: Enter new industry verticals and geographic markets

Brand Awareness: Increase Robi recognition in target enterprise segments

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



30 Days



Set up and launch first "Critical Four" marketing campaigns

Establish baseline metrics and reporting dashboards

Begin generating consistent inbound lead flow to Client Services team

90 Days



Achieve target lead generation volume with acceptable quality scores

Optimize campaigns based on performance data and Client Services feedback

Expand successful tactics and pause underperforming initiatives

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Cybersecurity Engineer

We are seeking a skilled Cybersecurity Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions that protect our organization's infrastructure, applications, and data. This role goes beyond monitoring and analysis to actively build, configure, and remediate security systems and controls.

Key Responsibilities

Security Architecture & Implementation



Design and implement security architectures for networks, systems, and applications

Build and deploy security tools, controls, and monitoring solutions

Configure and optimize firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and endpoint security

Develop and implement zero-trust security models and network segmentation



Security System Engineering



Engineer and maintain SIEM platforms, log aggregation, and security orchestration systems

Automate security processes and i
 response workflows

Integrate security tools with existing infrastructure and DevOps pipelines

Build custom security solutions and scripts to address specific organizational needs



Vulnerability Remediation & Hardening



Remediate identified vulnerabilities across systems and applications

Implement security hardening standards for operating systems, databases, and applications

Patch management and security update deployment

Configure secure authentication systems including multi-factor authentication and SSO



Infrastructure Security



Secure cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) including IAM, encryption, and monitoring

Implement and maintain PKI infrastructure and certificate management

Configure and manage VPNs, secure remote access solutions, and network access controls

Design and implement disaster recovery and business continuity security measures



DevSecOps Integration



Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows

Implement security scanning and testing in development environments

Work with development teams to remediate application security issues

Build and maintain security testing frameworks and automated security validation



Required Qualifications

Education & Experience



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field

3-6 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity engineering or systems engineering

Proven experience implementing and maintaining security technologies



Technical Skills



Advanced knowledge of network security protocols, firewalls, and intrusion prevention systems

Experience with cloud security implementations (AWS Security, Azure Security Center, GCP Security)

Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, Ansible)

Experience with containerization security (Docker, Kubernetes)

Knowledge of encryption technologies and PKI implementation

Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elasticsearch, Sentinel)

Understanding of secure coding practices and application security testing



Security Frameworks & Compliance



Experience implementing controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST frameworks

Knowledge of regulatory requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, GDPR)

Experience with security assessments and audit remediation



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) platforms

Knowledge of threat hunting and digital forensics

Experience with identity and access management (IAM) solutions

Familiarity with security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus)

Experience with infrastructure as code and GitOps security practices



Certifications (Preferred)



Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)

AWS Certified Security - Specialty or Azure Security Engineer Associate

GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC) or GIAC Certified I
 Handler (GCIH)

Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)



Key Competencies



Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities

Excellent technical documentation and communication skills

Ability to work independently and manage multiple security projects

Strong understanding of business requirements and risk management

Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams

Continuous learning mindset to stay current with emerging threats and technologies



Problem-Solving Focus



Analytical mindset with ability to diagnose complex security issues

Proactive approach to identifying and addressing security gaps

Experience translating security requirements into technical solutions

Ability to balance security requirements with business operational needs

title: Accountant – Compilation & Year-End Accounting (Remote – Philippines)
description:
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-time; 40 hours per week

Location: Philippines

Working Hours: Must be available to work 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday, starting at either:

   9:00 AM Pacific Time (British Columbia), or

   9:00 AM Mountain Time (Alberta).



Candidates must be able to align their working schedules with Canadian business hours, including adjustments for daylight saving time.



Number of Openings: 1



About the Role



We are a Canadian CPA firm seeking an experienced, reliable, and detail-oriented Accountant based in the Philippines to support our Canadian accounting and year-end engagements remotely.



The ideal candidate will have a strong accounting background, experience preparing financial statements and working papers, and the ability to independently complete accounting tasks with accuracy and attention to detail.



Experience working with Canadian accounting firms, particularly in compilation engagements and year-end financial statement preparation, is highly preferred.



Responsibilities

• Prepare year-end working papers and supporting schedules for compilation engagements.

• Prepare financial statements and accompanying notes for compilation engagements in accordance with applicable Canadian standards.

• Perform bookkeeping reviews, account reconciliations, and general ledger analysis.

• Identify accounting discrepancies and prepare adjusting journal entries.

• Prepare and reconcile year-end schedules, including cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, investments, fixed assets, loans, accruals, and other balance sheet accounts.

• Review trial balances and general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Assist with year-end adjustments and financial statement preparation.

• Assist with maintaining and updating working paper files using CaseWare, where applicable.

• Organize accounting records and supporting documentation.

• Communicate with the Canadian accounting team regarding outstanding information, accounting issues, and required adjustments.

• Manage multiple assignments while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy.

• Maintain confidentiality of client financial information.



Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.

Previous experience in accounting, financial statement preparation, or year-end accounting engagements.

Experience preparing compilation engagement working papers and financial statements is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and general ledger accounting.

Experience preparing reconciliations, adjusting journal entries, and year-end schedules.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, reconciliations, and financial schedules.

Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem-solving abilities.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to work independently, follow instructions carefully, and complete assignments accurately.

Reliable, patient, responsible, and willing to learn.

Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Experience working with Canadian accounting firms and knowledge of Canadian accounting standards (ASPE) is a strong asset.

Experience with CaseWare Working Papers, CaseView, and QuickBooks Online (QBO) is an asset.

Familiarity with Canadian compilation engagement standards (CSRS 4200) is an asset.





How to Apply

Please submit the following:

Your résumé.

A brief summary of your accounting experience, particularly compilation engagements, financial statement preparation, and year-end accounting work.

Details of your experience with Canadian accounting firms, if applicable.

A list of accounting software you have used, particularly CaseWare, CaseView, QBO, and Microsoft Excel.

Your expected monthly compensation in PHP.

Your earliest available start date



Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical accounting assessment, which may include preparing adjusting journal entries, reconciling accounts, reviewing a trial balance, and completing sample year-end working papers.

title: IT Manager
description:
Starbond (CPH International LLC) is a US-based e-commerce brand (Amazon FBA, Walmart, Shopify) building a fully automated, AI-driven operation. We're hiring an IT Manager to own the infrastructure that keeps everything running.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every department — Supply Chain, HR, Operations, Finance — runs on integrations, automations, and AI agents that must work without interruption. One expired API token, one unmonitored server failure, or one credential in the wrong hands can stop the business. This role exists so that never happens, and so our automation roadmap keeps moving forward.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

1. Server infrastructure and uptime — Linux VPS environments running Python scripts and Google App Scripts 24/7

2. API and integration management — Gusto, Hubstaff, Cin7, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Seller Center, GPT / Claude / MCP connectors

3. AI agent deployment — building and maintaining autonomous agents across company workflows; every agent documented before going live

4. Credential security and access control — root credentials held exclusively by this role and the CEO; role-based access enforced across all platforms

5. ERP development — architecture, development, and maintenance of Starbond's custom parallel ERP system

6. IT helpdesk — structured intake, triage, and resolution of all IT support requests; critical issues resolved within 4 hours

7. Subscription and vendor management — monthly audits by the 5th of each month, cost and utilization data on every line item

8. Business continuity and disaster recovery — DR plan, biannual drills, documented RTO and RPO

9. IT project management — ClickUp backlog, bi-weekly status updates to leadership, IT Lead supervision



REQUIRED

Civil CADD / Geospatial Technician



Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time (0–5 Years Experience)



About the Role



As a Civil CADD / Geospatial Technician, you will play a central role in delivering high-quality transportation and infrastructure design projects for our local agency clients. Working in close collaboration with project engineers, you will bridge technical design and drafting execution, transforming 3D scan data and survey details into precise, production-ready engineering plans.



If you bring sharp attention to detail, strong technical curiosity, and clear communication skills, this role offers an exceptional platform to grow your career across CADD, LiDAR/point cloud processing, and GIS technology.



Key Responsibilities



CAD & Civil Design Execution: Generate 3D terrain models, corridors, alignments, cross-sections, and plan sheets using Bentley OpenRoads Designer (ORD) and MicroStation.

Point Cloud & LiDAR Data Processing: Extract existing topographic features, linework, and surface models from 3D laser scan data utilizing TopoDOT in MicroStation.

Plan & Detail Production: Draft civil roadway plans, structural drawings, profiles, and detail sheets adhering strictly to client and IDOT CADD standards.

GIS Integration: Utilize ArcGIS Pro and ArcMap to access, evaluate, and integrate spatial data into active engineering workflows.

Engineering Calculations & Support: Perform earthwork computations, quantity takeoffs, dimensional checks, and routine design support for project engineers.

Standards & Compliance: Review and interpret technical CADD specifications, state DOT standards, and local agency requirements.

Continuous Learning: Stay current with evolving CADD software, geospatial technology, point cloud extraction techniques, and industry best practices.

Project Documentation & Collaboration: Support team organization and communication using Microsoft Office (Excel/Word) and Google Workspace.



Qualifications & Requirements



Education: Associate degree or technical degree in Civil Engineering Technology, CADD, Surveying/Geospatial Technology, or equivalent experience.

Experience: 0–5 years of practical experience in civil drafting or design support.

Core CADD Tools: Proficiency or working knowledge of MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer (ORD)**.

Point Cloud Tech: Familiarity or hands-on experience using TopoDOT for point cloud feature extraction.

GIS Tools: Working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro and/or ArcMap.

Standards Knowledge: Basic plan-reading skills and familiarity with **IDOT** and local agency CADD standards.

Software Tools: Comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Word, and Google Workspace.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills



Experience or familiarity with Autodesk Civil 3D.

Prior exposure to mobile or static LiDAR point cloud datasets.



 Key Strengths for Success



Detail-Oriented Precision: Strong commitment to accuracy in calculations, sheet layouts, and drafting standards.

Collaborative Mindset: Proactive communication with project engineers, surveyors, and CADD teammates.

Adaptability: Willingness to learn new CADD tools, software updates, and geospatial workflows.

Develop architectural designs and construction documents for residential and commercial projects

Ensure all designs comply with applicable building codes, zoning ordinances, and HOA requirements

Collaborate on grading, drainage, utility layouts, and site access

Manage project documentation and design revisions throughout all project phases

Prepare visual materials (renderings, diagrams) to facilitate client understanding

Other tasks as requested by the leadership team



Qualifications



Minimum of 3 – 5 years of experience in residential architecture

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture from an accredited institution

Licensed Architect (or actively pursuing licensure) preferred

Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit; experience with SketchUp or other visualization tools is a plus

Working knowledge of US residential building codes (IRC), zoning regulations, and permitting processes

Strong technical drawing skills with a high attention to detail

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

Experience working with US-based clients or on US residential projects is strongly preferred

Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a distributed team

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote, Full-Time): AI Scheduling for US Dental Practices
description:
ChairMint | Remote: Philippines only | Full-time, 40 hrs/week | Long-term, starting with a 12-week MVP | $2,500 to $4,000 USD/month



About ChairMint Every empty dental chair is lost revenue and a patient who didn't get care. ChairMint is an AI scheduling platform for dental practices across the US. It connects to a practice's scheduling system, spots cancellations and open slots, ranks the best patients to offer them to (waitlist, overdue recall, unscheduled treatment), and reaches out by AI voice call, SMS, and
. The practice approves, and ChairMint books the appointment straight back into the schedule.



We're at the pilot stage. A clickable sales demo exists, and we are now building the pilot-ready MVP for our first founding practices. ChairMint was founded by a dental billing and operations professional. You'll be our first engineer, own the backend and integrations end to end, and work directly with the founder.



What you'll build in the first 12 weeks (six 2-week sprints, starting Monday, November 9, 2026)



- Weeks 1-2, Foundations: TypeScript monorepo, CI on GitHub Actions, HIPAA-eligible infrastructure as code on AWS (or Aptible), multi-tenant Postgres schema, MFA login, append-only audit log, PHI-safe logging  

- Weeks 3-4, Integration: NexHealth Synchronizer API client, initial and incremental sync, signed webhooks, and gap detection on the NexHealth sandbox, behind an adapter so other PMS integrations can be added later  

- Weeks 5-6, Ranking: candidate builder plus a transparent, explainable weighted ranking (no black-box ML) and a practice approval queue  

- Weeks 7-8, Outreach and booking: Twilio SMS (A2P 10DLC, consent, STOP/HELP) and
, atomic slot holds, and write-back to the schedule  

- Weeks 9-10, Voice: AI voice calls with Retell AI on Twilio, the full call-then-text-then
 sequence with frequency caps and kill switches, and an operator console  

- Weeks 11-12, Pilot readiness: dashboard, Stripe attendance-based billing, monitoring and alarms, backup restore test, runbooks



Our stack TypeScript and Node.js 20+ (Fastify or NestJS), React 18 + Vite, PostgreSQL 16 (pg-boss for jobs), AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, KMS, Secrets Manager; CDK or Terraform) or Aptible, GitHub Actions, Twilio Programmable Messaging and Voice, Retell AI, NexHealth Synchronizer API, Stripe Billing, Paubox
. The architecture and sprint plan are written; you'll help make the remaining calls (for example AWS vs Aptible).



Must have



- 6+ years building production web apps; strong TypeScript and Node.js on the back end plus working React  

- Has shipped third-party API integrations end to end: webhooks and signature checks, retries, idempotency, rate limits, sync conflicts  

- Production Twilio experience (SMS and/or Voice)  

- Has worked with PHI or other regulated data: encryption, access control, audit logs, BAAs  

- Postgres data modeling and SQL; deploying and running services on AWS (or a PaaS like Aptible)  

- Strong communicator: clear, confident written and spoken English; proactive status updates; comfortable explaining technical trade-offs to a non-engineering founder and raising blockers early  

- Based in the Philippines. At least 3 to 4 hours a day of overlap with US Pacific business hours. PH-friendly window: 6:00 to 10:00 AM Philippine time = 2:00 to 6:00 PM Pacific (Nov to Mar, PST) or 3:00 to 7:00 PM Pacific (Mar to Nov, PDT). An evening PH shift (e.g., 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM PH time) is also welcome; the rest of the day can be async



Nice to have



- AI voice agents (Retell AI, Vapi, Bland, or OpenAI Realtime) and LLM prompt/tool design  

- Dental or healthcare scheduling: Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Denticon, or NexHealth/Sikka/Kolla APIs  

- A2P 10DLC registration, TCPA consent and opt-out handling, messaging deliverability  

- Stripe Billing (usage-based invoicing), AWS CDK or Terraform, SOC 2 or HIPAA audit prep  

- Founding-engineer or 0-to-1 startup experience



Compensation and terms



- $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience (plus a 13th-month bonus after 12 months)  

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, as a remote independent contractor, paid monthly in USD  

- Starts with the 12-week MVP; we are hiring for the long term  

- Paid take-home exercise for finalists ($300 flat)  

- You provide a reliable computer (encrypted, with screen lock) and stable internet; backup power and internet are strongly recommended



How we work Two-week sprints with a short planning session, a brief async daily update (never any PHI), and a demo every other Friday. Every change goes through a pull request. You'll have a written technical blueprint, sprint plan, and backlog on day one.



HIPAA and security expectations (required for everyone who works on ChairMint)



- Test data only until BAAs are signed: until ChairMint's business associate agreements with practices and vendors are in place, all work uses fictional or sandbox data (NexHealth sandbox, Twilio test credentials, Retell test agents). No real patient data on your computer, in personal accounts, in tickets or chat, or in AI tools that are not covered by a BAA.  

- HIPAA training: complete HIPAA and security training (certificate on file) before you get access to any system that could hold PHI, and refresh it every year.  

- Company-owned GitHub and accounts: all code lives in ChairMint's GitHub organization, where you are a member, not an owner. AWS or Aptible, Twilio, Retell AI, NexHealth, Stripe, and
 accounts are owned by ChairMint, and you get your own named login. No personal repos, no shared logins.  

- IP assignment and confidentiality: you'll sign an independent contractor agreement with IP assignment (everything you build for ChairMint belongs to ChairMint), an NDA, and business associate (subcontractor) terms that cover PHI.  

- Access controls: least-privilege access, MFA on every account, a company password manager, an encrypted device with screen lock, secrets in a secrets manager (never in code), any suspected incident reported within 24 hours, and same-day access removal when the engagement ends.  

- You'll also build these safeguards into the product: encryption in transit and at rest, tenant isolation, audit logging, and no PHI in logs, analytics, or URLs.  

- Production access: during the MVP you'll work in local and staging environments with fictional or sandbox data. Access to production patient data stays restricted unless and until it is cleared under ChairMint's BAAs and contracts.



Hiring process and timeline We review applications daily starting Sunday, November 1. Next: a 15-minute intro call, a 45-minute technical and product conversation (from Monday, November 2), a paid 4 to 6 hour take-home exercise using mock data only (flat $300), and references. Target start: Monday, November 9, 2026.



How to apply Send the following with your application. Please also include your monthly rate, time zone, which hours you can overlap with US Pacific time, any other work commitments, and your earliest start date. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



1. Your GitHub profile or a code sample you wrote yourself (tell us which file or folder to look at).  

2. A 2-minute Loom walking us through a similar project you built (an integration, scheduling, messaging, or healthcare app). Do not show real patient data or a past client's confidential information.  

3. Short answers to these 3 questions: Q1. Tell us about a production integration you built with a third-party API (ideally healthcare, scheduling, or a practice-management/EHR system). What broke, and how did you handle webhooks, retries, idempotency, or rate limits? Q2. How have you protected PHI or other regulated data? Name the safeguards you implemented yourself (for example encryption, least-privilege access, audit logs, keeping PHI out of logs) and say whether you worked under a BAA. Q3. Describe your Twilio experience (SMS and/or Voice, A2P 10DLC, STOP/HELP handling, delivery webhooks) and any AI voice agent work (Retell AI, Vapi, or similar). What was the hardest part?

title: Part-Time Phone Appointment Setter: Call Dentists Who Requested Information
description:
We run professional training for dentists. Dentists fill in a form, ask for information and agree to be contacted. We need a calm, clear English speaker to call them and book the right ones in with our director.



These are warm leads, not a cold list. Some may not remember filling in the form, so you open every call by reminding them how they got in touch. If someone says no, you thank them and move on.



The work:

- Call dentists who requested information. Ask about their goals, experience and timing, and answer only from the information sheet we give you.

- Book qualified dentists in with our director. You do not close, take payments or give clinical advice.

- Leave short CRM notes and send a brief daily report.



What we give you:

- The leads, a script to learn and an information sheet.

- For shortlisted applicants, a short AI practice call (5 to 8 minutes) with a made-up lead. You are told it is an AI, and it is recorded.



Pay:

- US$5 to 8 per hour plus about US$10 per attended call.

- The pilot is 10 hours a week for four weeks, and it is paid. The trial is always paid.

- We never charge applicants for anything.

- Terms are confirmed in writing before work starts.



How we measure the work: calls made, conversations, bookings and attended calls. Calls may be recorded where the law allows, and the dentist is told at the start. We listen to help you improve.



You suit this if you:

- Speak clear, friendly English and listen well.

- Have a quiet space, a headset and stable internet.

- Can cover calling windows for Australia, the UK, Canada and the US East Coast (evening hours in the Philippines).

- Have phone sales, appointment setting or customer service experience.



How to apply:

1. Apply through this platform only.

2. Start with the word BLUE, so we know you read this.

3. Add a 60-second voice note: introduce yourself and say how you would open a call with a dentist who asked for information.

4. Include your rate, time zone, calling windows, one result you achieved yourself (no names) and short answers to the 10 questions below.



Shortlisted applicants do the AI practice call, then a short final call. A person listens to every recording. Everyone who reaches a call gets an answer within 7 days of applying.



Questions:

1. Which warm leads have you personally called? Give the period, calls, conversations, bookings and your role.

3. What do you ask before d
 to book a call with the director?

title: Creator Research Specialist
description:
Scope of Work (General Job Description)



RESEARCH SPECIALIST needed to build a list of finance short-form video creators (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) for topic research. The list has one job: capture what topics actually perform — every row must include the creator's top-performing videos so I can study what works.



Your outcome is to:

1. Build a list of 50 finance short-form creators within the parameters below who match our requirements.

2. Focus on creators with real engagement, not just follower counts. Average views matter more than followers.

3. Every row must include topic research. No rows without top-performing videos.



Key Bullet Points

• Required: FINANCE-FOCUSED short-form creator — the majority of their videos must be about investing, personal finance, markets, economics, or fintech. A lifestyle creator who "sometimes talks about money" does not count.

• Required: Active in the last 30 days — at least 4 finance videos posted in the last 30 days. Short-form moves fast; dormant accounts are useless.

• Required: 50,000–1,000,000 followers on their primary platform. Big enough to matter, small enough to be able to replicate their content. (Mega-creators with millions of followers are ok. Note them separately if you find good ones, but they don't count toward the 50.)

• Required: Top 3 performing videos linked for EVERY row. Video link plus view count. This is the topic research; do not skip it.

• Required: Submit a list of exactly 50 creators. No duplicates.

• Ideal: Leans on credibility/authority positioning (credentials, career background, "ex-Wall Street" style framing) — these are the best comps for my positioning, so flag them.

• Ideal: Strong engagement - average views at least 10% of follower count, or clearly viral outliers in recent videos.

• Ideal: Already does brand deals or sponsorships (proven they treat it as a business).



Overview & Details

I'm a software engineer at a big tech company (Princeton grad, 2350/2400 SAT) and have been investing early across different vehicles and learned a lot from doing so. I started out reselling things at a young age to get my first capital though. I'm building short-form finance video content (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), explaining investing and personal finance related topics. My positioning leans on real credentials and clear explanations, not hype. I want to study what topics perform. The list exists as a topic-research database I can mine for video ideas.

Good audience fit: retail investors, savers, and personal-finance learners, people who watch short videos to get smarter about money.



Your goal is to build a list of 50 ideal creators for topic research.



Examples of Creators We've Looked At

• "Humphrey Yang — TikTok/YouTube Shorts, ex-financial advisor, explains complex finance topics in 60 seconds with pop-culture hooks. Type of creator we want: credible background, short-form native, consistent poster. (Too big at 3M+ followers to count toward the 50 — direction example only.)"

• "Vivian Tu / Your Rich BFF — TikTok/Instagram, former Wall Street trader, personal finance made accessible. Great topic research: see which of her money-tip formats go viral. (Too big — direction example only.)"

• "Jim Wang 
 — won Best Short-Form Content at the 2026 FinTalk Awards. Exactly the tier and format we're targeting: recognized short-form finance creator."

• "Erika Kullberg — attorney + personal finance, 9M+ TikTok, consumer money tips and legal money hacks. Study her hook style. 

(These are direction examples for content style and topic research, not exclusions — the 50 rows should be creators in the 50k–1M band. Your judgment on fit matters more than copying the examples.)



List Building Details

Please build the list in a Google Sheet. Include the following columns:

• Creator name / handle — name and @handle.

• Primary platform — TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts (note if active on multiple).

• Profile link — direct link to their profile.

• Follower count — count and platform ("~85k TikTok followers").

• Average views — rough average views per finance video over the last 30 days.

• Finance niche — one line: value investing, personal finance, crypto, day trading, budgeting, etc.

• Creator contact — business
 from bio/Linktree if available; otherwise business-inquiry link. Never leave this blank.

• Contact type — 
" or "DM/link" (so I know how warm the row is).

• Top 3 videos — links to their 3 highest-viewed finance videos, with view counts. This is the topic research — the most important column after contact info.

• Posting cadence — videos per week (from recent activity).

• Description — a short description of why this creator was selected and why they'd be a good contact (2-3 sentences).



How This Hire Works

1. Apply as described below. Applications that skip the sample creators will not be considered — that sample is the first test.

2. Shortlisted applicants (2–3) will be offered a paid sample test: a small slice of the real list (5 completed rows in the full column format above), fixed price, with a stated deadline.

3. The winner of the paid test builds the full 50-creator list at the fixed price agreed in the application stage. Payment is direct (EasyPay or Wise) — no hourly billing.



To Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph for this job post, with the application title: "Finance Short-Form Creator List Building Application"

INCLUDE:

• 3-5 finance short-form creators you think would be ideal for this project — handle, platform, profile link, and follower count for each. And tell me WHY you chose them (2-3 sentences each). Include one of their top-performing video topics. Thoughtful descriptions will get you the job. This is the most important part of the application.

• A short description of your experience building contact/research lists, and why you're confident you can do this work.

• Your expected turnaround time to build the 50-creator list.

• Estimated number of hours to complete list



We will NOT consider:

• Applications that don't include the correct title or 3-5 ideal creators.

• Any AI written submissions.

Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.
