title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner
description:
Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner



Zelin & Associates CPA, LLC   Midtown Manhattan, New York



About Zelin & Associates

Zelin & Associates CPA, LLC is an established CPA firm in Midtown Manhattan that has been serving individuals, small businesses, and nonprofit organizations throughout the New York and New Jersey area since 2008.

We are a team of knowledgeable, friendly professionals who work hard to earn our role as trusted advisers to our clients. As a full-service boutique CPA firm, we pride ourselves on providing highly personalized, responsive service and delivering quality work on a timely basis.



Position Mission

The Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner is a high-impact, trust-based role at the center of a growing, deadline-driven accounting firm.



This is not a traditional administrative assistant position. We are looking for someone with an accounting background who can combine strong executive support, organization, technology, and business process automation skills to help the Managing Partner and the firm operate more effectively.



You will serve as a central point of organization, communication, and follow-through, ensuring that priorities are clear, commitments are tracked, deadlines are met, and important matters do not fall through the cracks.



The right person will bring structure to a fast-moving environment by managing priorities, coordinating schedules, overseeing workflows, following up on outstanding items, and keeping communication moving between the Managing Partner, staff, clients, and outside professionals.



Just as importantly, we want someone who looks at existing processes and asks, "Is there a better way to do this?" You will be expected to identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve workflows, and use technology to make the firm more efficient and scalable.



Your work will allow the Managing Partner to remain focused on clients, technical matters, firm strategy, and growth, with confidence that priorities and commitments are being actively managed.



As the firm grows, this position has the potential to expand into a broader leadership role overseeing administrative support and helping improve firm-wide processes and workflows.



Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Help manage and protect the Managing Partner's time and priorities, ensuring important matters are planned, tracked, followed up on, and completed on time.

• Manage a busy calendar, schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts.

• Assist with daily
 and inbox management, identifying items requiring immediate attention and ensuring appropriate follow-up.

• Monitor the Managing Partner's timesheet and help ensure time is recorded accurately and promptly.

• Maintain and monitor priority lists, open items, deadlines, client deliverables, and follow-up items.

• Serve as a trusted communication hub between the Managing Partner, firm staff, clients, vendors, and outside professionals.

• Help coordinate firm projects and workflows and follow up with team members on deadlines and outstanding items.

• Assist with client communications, meeting preparation, business development activities, and professional follow-up.

• Help organize, document, and improve internal administrative systems, procedures, checklists, and workflows.

• Identify potential problems, missed deadlines, or unresolved matters before they become urgent.

• Take ownership of assignments and follow them through to completion rather than simply passing information along.

• Identify repetitive administrative and accounting-related processes that can be standardized, streamlined, or automated.

• Design and maintain efficient workflows for recurring tasks, client follow-ups, document collection, deadline tracking, approvals, and internal processes.

• Use technology and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and reduce the risk of important tasks being overlooked.

• Help integrate and improve the firm's accounting, practice-management, communication, and productivity systems.

• Provide additional hands-on support during periods of significant workload or important filing deadlines.



Accounting Background Required

An accounting background is an important requirement for this position.



The successful candidate should have prior experience working in accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or within a CPA/accounting firm.



This role requires someone who is comfortable with accounting terminology and understands that client work revolves around financial information, tax filings, financial statements, document requests, regulatory deadlines, and other time-sensitive deliverables.



You do not necessarily need to be a CPA, but you should understand the context of the work well enough to recognize priorities, communicate effectively with accounting professionals and clients, and know when something requires immediate attention.



Candidates whose experience is exclusively general administrative or executive assistance without meaningful accounting or CPA-firm exposure may not be the right fit for this particular role.



Technology & Business Process Automation

Proficiency in business process automation is an important requirement for this position.

We are looking for someone who does more than simply complete repetitive administrative tasks. The successful candidate should naturally look for opportunities to make processes faster, more reliable, more organized, and less dependent on manual follow-up.

You should be comfortable using technology to build and improve workflows, including tools such as Microsoft 365, Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate, Microsoft Forms, and AI/productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms.

Experience using automation to improve processes such as task management,
 and client follow-up, document requests, approvals, recurring deadlines, data collection, reporting, or administrative workflows is strongly preferred.



We are particularly interested in someone who can look at a process and ask:

• Can this be automated?

• Can unnecessary steps be eliminated?

• Can information flow more efficiently between systems?

• Can we create a better system for tracking responsibilities and deadlines?

• Can technology reduce the risk of something being overlooked?

• Can this process be documented so another team member can perform it consistently?



The goal is not automation for its own sake. The goal is to use technology intelligently to make the firm more efficient, responsive, scalable, and reliable.



What We're Looking For

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Have prior experience in an accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or CPA-firm environment.

• Have experience supporting a partner, owner, executive, or other senior professional.

• Have demonstrated experience with business process improvement and workflow automation.

• Are proficient with Microsoft 365 and comfortable using technology to streamline and automate business processes.

• Can identify repetitive or inefficient processes and develop practical solutions rather than simply continuing to perform them manually.

• Are comfortable learning new applications and figuring out how different systems and processes can work together.

• Have an interest in AI and emerging productivity tools and are comfortable applying them responsibly to improve day-to-day operations.

• Are highly organized and exceptionally detail-oriented.

• Are naturally proactive and do not need to be reminded repeatedly about follow-up.

• Take ownership of responsibilities and enjoy being the person others can depend on.

• Are comfortable managing multiple competing priorities and changing deadlines.

• Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently.

• Exercise excellent judgment and discretion when handling confidential client and firm information.

• Can distinguish between what is truly urgent, what is important, and what can wait.

• Enjoy creating structure and organization in a busy professional environment.



Work Ethic and Availability

Accounting is a deadline-driven profession, and workloads are not always evenly distributed throughout the year.

We are looking for someone who understands that there will be periods when the firm is exceptionally busy and everyone needs to step up to get the job done.



This position requires someone who is:

• Willing to work hard and take on additional responsibility when workloads increase.

• Flexible when important client, tax, audit, or regulatory deadlines require additional attention.

• Willing to work additional hours when reasonably necessary during peak periods.

• Able to remain calm, organized, responsive, and dependable when several urgent matters arise at the same time.

• A genuine team player who is willing to pitch in and help wherever reasonably needed to meet the firm's commitments.



We believe strongly in working intelligently, creating efficient systems, and using technology to reduce unnecessary work. At the same time, when an important deadline is approaching, we need someone who is committed to doing what is reasonably necessary to help the team deliver for our clients.



Why This Role Matters

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being the person who:

• Keeps a busy leader focused and organized.

• Brings structure to complexity.

• Makes sure commitments don't get forgotten.

• Anticipates what needs to happen next.

• Prevents small problems from becoming larger ones.

• Finds better, more efficient ways to get work done.

• Uses technology and automation to eliminate unnecessary manual work.

• Takes genuine satisfaction in seeing work completed properly and on time.

• Wants to grow alongside an established CPA firm.



The right person will become a trusted and important part of our firm's day-to-day operations.



As the firm continues to grow, there is an opportunity for this position to evolve into a larger operational and leadership role, including responsibility for coordinating or overseeing additional administrative support and helping develop more efficient firm-wide systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note explaining why your accounting background, organizational skills, and experience with business process automation make you a strong fit for this position.



To help us know that you have read the entire job description carefully, please include the phrase " Karaoke Ready" in the subject line of your response.



If you have an accounting background, are proficient in business process automation, take pride in being highly dependable, and are looking for a role where your organization, judgment, technology skills, initiative, and work ethic can make a meaningful difference, we would like to hear from you.

You enjoy detailed administrative work

Speaking with clients on the phone 



Drafting client
s (hold reminders, confirmation, follow-ups, courtesy responses, answer inquiries)

Expectation:

title: Backend SEO & AEO Operations Manager for US Marketing Agency (Full-Time)
description:
About us

BoosterProfile is a US marketing agency. We help local home service companies (roofers, HVAC, contractors and more) get more calls from Google Maps, Google search and AI search like ChatGPT. We work with about 20 US business owners and add new ones every week.



The role

We run our fulfillment with an AI system (Claude) that does most of the hands-on work: Google Business Profile optimization, posts, keyword maps, rank tracking, WordPress sites and reports. We need one person who owns the backend and runs that system day to day, so the owner never has to think about it. You're the SEO brain behind it: local SEO, AI search (AEO), analytics, and Google Ads for the clients who run them.



What you'll do

- Get every new client set up: GBP manager access, website and DNS logins, GoHighLevel sub-account, tracking numbers

- Handle Google Business Profile verifications, suspensions and reinstatements

- Check how each client shows up in AI search (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini) and fix what's missing: schema, FAQs, citations, reviews, service and city pages

- Set up and read GA4 and Google Search Console for every client, and flag drops in traffic, calls or rankings

- Help manage Google Ads and Local Services Ads for the clients who run them

- Run A2P 10DLC registration for client texting (we give you the step-by-step)

- Check the AI's work before it goes live: GBP edits, site pages, posts, keyword lists

- Work through the daily task and approval list so nothing waits on the owner

- Watch our alerts. When something breaks, find out why and fix it or flag it fast.

- Keep the delivery tracker (Google Sheets) up to date



You're a fit if

- You've done local SEO or Google Business Profile work for US clients (agency experience is a big plus)

- You've handled GBP verification or suspension cases

- You understand AEO: how AI assistants pick which businesses to recommend, and what moves it (schema, citations, reviews, clear service pages)

- You've set up GA4 and Search Console and can explain what the numbers mean

- Bonus: Google Ads or Local Services Ads experience

- You're comfortable with WordPress, GoHighLevel and Google Sheets

- You already use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your work and like working with them

- You're careful. You check before you click publish.

- Your written English is clear



Hours

40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with at least 4 hours overlapping US Pacific business hours.



How we hire

15-minute video call, then a 30-day paid trial, then full-time.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are not read)

Start your application with the words "Backend Ready" and paste your Loom link (loom.com, free).



Your Loom must:

1. Be under 5 minutes, with your camera on at the start so we can see you

2. Say your name, where you're based, and how long you've done local SEO or Google Business Profile work

3. Share your screen and show a Google Business Profile you've managed and optimized. Show it from the inside (the manager view where you edit it), not just the public Google Maps listing. Tell us what you changed and what moved.

4. Show a website you've built. Show the live site and the editor or admin behind it (WordPress or similar), plus its Search Console or GA4 if you have it.

5. Answer three questions out loud:

   - You're building a brand new website for a roofing company. What are the top 3 things you make sure are in place before it goes live, and why?

   - A client's Google Business Profile just got suspended. What are the first 3 things you do?

   - How would you check whether ChatGPT recommends a business?

6. End by saying the words "Backend Ready"



No Loom, no review.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels, Shorts, and Social Content (30–180 sec)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We are a real estate company that produces long-form video content across education, investment, faith and land development topics. We need a short-form editor who can take that long-form content and clip it into high-performing short-form videos for Reels, Shorts, and social platforms. Occasionally you will also create variations of existing short-form clips for use as ads.

 

This is a high-volume, ongoing role. If your edits perform, there's consistent work and performance bonuses on top of your per-video rate.

 

---

 

SCOPE

 

Short-form videos between 30 and 180 seconds, repurposed from long-form source content. Up to 25 videos per week, capped at 100 per month. Each video must be fully platform-ready on delivery — no open loops.

 

Primary: Clipping and editing short-form content from long-form recordings

Secondary: Creating ad variations from existing short-form clips

 

---

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN EVERY EDIT

 

- Hook mastery — you can identify the strongest moments in a long-form video and know how to open with a visual hook, text hook, and audio hook that stops the scroll in the first 2–3 seconds

- Body retention — the middle holds attention as well as the opening; pacing, pattern interrupts, and visual momentum throughout

- Smooth call to action — the CTA feels like a natural close, not a hard sell bolted on at the end

- Effective audio — music and sound design that reinforces the message and energy without overpowering it; aligned with brand, not exaggerated

- Brand alignment — every clip should feel like it belongs to the same family of content; consistent tone, text style, and visual rhythm

- Platform awareness — you know what works on Reels vs. Shorts and can optimize accordingly without being told

 

---

 

SKILLS REQUIRED

 

- Strong short-form portfolio — share examples that show you can pull compelling clips from long-form source material

- Proven understanding of what makes short-form content perform, not just look good

- Experience creating ad variations from organic short-form content

- Captions, text overlays, and on-screen graphics that complement — not clutter — the video

- Comfortable working at volume with fast turnaround

- Familiar with 
 for review and approval, and Google Drive for final file delivery

 

---

 

WORKFLOW

 

You'll receive long-form source footage and a brief for each batch. Edits are submitted to 
 for review and approval. Once approved, final files are uploaded to a designated Google Drive folder per the instructions provided.

 

---

 

COMPENSATION

 

- Rate: $15 per approved video

- Max volume: 100 videos/month (~25/week)

- Monthly cap: $1,500/month

- Performance bonuses: available for videos that hit strong view, reach, and engagement benchmarks

 

Pay is strictly per approved and delivered video. Only videos that clear the 
 approval process count toward your monthly total. There is no guaranteed floor — you are paid for what you deliver.

 

Videos that consistently perform well are eligible for bonuses. We track what works and reward the edits that drive results. Strong, consistent output over time opens the door to increased volume and rate.

 

---

 

TO APPLY — ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS IN YOUR PROPOSAL

 

1. Walk me through how you identify the best clips inside a long-form video. What are you looking for, and how do you d
 where to start and end a clip?

 

2. Share 2–3 short-form videos you edited that were repurposed from long-form content — and tell us what you were trying to accomplish with each one beyond just making it look good.

 

3. How do you use audio in a short-form video? What's your approach to music selection and sound design for a professional brand that wants energy without feeling overhyped?

title: Market Research Analyst for US Marketing Agency
description:
Market Research Analyst for US Marketing Agency (Full Time, Long Term)



$1,000 to $1,500 USD per month depending on experience.

40 hours per week, Los Angeles time.



ABOUT US



We are a performance marketing agency in Los Angeles. Since 2011

we have grown consumer brands doing $1m to $20m in sales. Our clients

sell watches, skincare and outdoor equipment. There are fifteen of us,

across LA, Chicago, Manchester and Rio.



This role reports to our Partner. Before he walks into a room with a

founder, everything he knows about that business comes from you. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You build the research pack for every client. Six parts:



1. THE NUMBERS

   Decompose the client's revenue into traffic, conversion, average

   order value and orders per customer. Pull twelve months from

   Shopify, GA4 and the ad platforms. Put the category benchmark

   beside each one. The branch with the biggest gap is the finding.



2. CUSTOMER LANGUAGE

   Mine 200+ reviews from their site, Amazon, Trustpilot, Google and

   Reddit. We do not want a summary. We want the recurring phrases,

   grouped by theme, WITH A COUNT. If forty people wrote "finally

   something that fits" and nobody wrote "premium," that is the

   finding and we need to see it.



3. INTERVIEWS

   We interview twelve people per client: recent buyers, people who

   bought a competitor instead, people who bought once and never came

   back. You source them from the client's own data, write the guide,

   and code every transcript afterwards for what pushed them, what

   pulled them, what made them anxious, and what nearly kept them

   where they were.



4. THE COMPETITIVE SET

   Pull every competitor's live ads from Meta Ad Library and TikTok

   Creative Center. What they claim, what they offer, and HOW LONG

   EACH AD HAS BEEN RUNNING, because longevity means it is working.



5. PRICING AND CATEGORY

   Price map every competitor by product tier. Shipping thresholds.

   Ninety days of discount behaviour. Then category size, growth rate

   and the client's share.



6. BRAND TRACKING

   Coordinate a quarterly panel study measuring how many category

   buyers associate the client with each buying occasion, and how

   that compares to competitors. You brief the vendor, check the

   data, and chart the movement quarter on quarter.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Native level written English. You will be reading reviews for tone

  and nuance, not counting keywords

- Real desk research experience. This is not data entry and it is not

  a virtual assistant role

- The ability to compress fifty pages into one page without losing

  the point. This is the single most important skill in the job

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and with numbers. You should be able

  to work out a conversion rate and spot when one looks wrong

- Disciplined about AI. Use it constantly, verify everything. We check



NICE TO HAVE



- Ecommerce or consumer brand experience

- Any experience with survey or panel research

- Experience writing something another person had to present



WHAT THIS IS NOT



- Not a VA role. No calendars, no inboxes, no admin

- Not SEO keyword research

- Not writing blog posts



TOOLS



You should already be fluent in the free ones, which do most of the

work: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Google Ads

Transparency Center, Google Trends.



Useful if you have it: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Similarweb, Statista,

Helium 10.



More important than any of those: tell us about a time you had to

find a number nobody had published. Public filings, trade bodies,

industry reports, whatever you had to dig through. That is most of

this job.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word AUDIENCE so we know you read this.



Then send:



1. One paragraph on a consumer brand you know well, saying what you

   think its real positioning is. Not its tagline. What it actually

   means to the people who buy it.

2. Any research document you have produced, with client details

   removed.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid 90 minute task: we name a consumer

brand, you find 40 of its reviews, pull out the recurring phrases

customers use, group them, and tell us in one page what those

customers actually value, with counts. We pay $30 for it whether or

not we hire you.

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions Closer
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY:

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: AI Ad Maker / Video Editor
description:
About RealTime Systems

RealTime Systems generates homeowner leads for local service businesses, with a focus on custom closets and home improvement. We create ads that show homeowners what these businesses offer and give them a reason to take the next step.



About the role



 I'm hiring an AI Ad Maker who can take my ideas and turn them into finished video ads.



I'll provide the concept, direction, references, and feedback. You'll handle the production: plan the shots, generate or source the visuals, assemble the footage, edit the video, and deliver a finished ad ready for review.



You should be comfortable working through imperfect AI results, spotting what looks wrong, and finding a better way to get the shot. The standard is the finished video: clear, visually convincing, well-paced, and faithful to the brief.



What you'll do



- Turn supplied ideas, scripts, and references into short-form video ads for
 and Instagram.

- Break a concept into shots and d
 which visuals need to be generated, edited, or built from existing assets.

- Use AI image, video, and voice tools where they fit the concept.

- Edit complete videos, including pacing, transitions, voiceover, music, sound effects, and captions where needed.

- Catch visual artifacts, inconsistent characters or environments, awkward movement, spelling errors, and audio problems before submitting work.

- Create variations of approved ads by changing openings, scenes, pacing, or other elements in the brief.

- Apply feedback accurately and communicate early when a shot, deadline, or instruction needs attention.

- Keep source assets, project files, and exports organized so work can be reviewed and revised easily.

- Keep learning and improving your production workflow as the tools develop.

What you need

- Hands-on AI video experience. You've made finished videos using AI tools and can show examples.

- Strong editing fundamentals. You understand pacing, composition, continuity, sound, and readable captions.

- Good visual judgment. You can recognize weak footage and fix or replace it.

- Independent execution. You can take a concept and work through production without needing every step explained.

- Clear written English. You can understand briefs, communicate questions, and catch errors in on-screen text.

- Reliable delivery. You meet agreed deadlines and flag problems early.

- Comfort with feedback. You can make revisions, learn from them, and improve the next version.

Experience with paid social ads, home improvement content, or realistic AI footage is useful. Equivalent tools and workflows are welcome. The quality of your work matters more than a particular software brand.



How we'll work together



You'll work directly with me. I own the ad ideas and overall direction, and you'll own turning them into finished videos. I expect you to make sensible production choices and speak up when something in the brief is unclear or could be executed better.



Feedback will be direct and specific. We'll agree on deadlines, production expectations, and quality standards. You'll be expected to apply feedback, meet those standards, and keep developing your skills.



How to apply



Submit your resume, at least one video you personally created, and a short explanation of your contribution and the AI/editing tools you used.



You can upload files or share accessible links. 



Submit existing work; you do not need to create a new video to apply.



I'll review your resume and work example first. Candidates who pass that review will be invited to a one-to-one interview to discuss their work, production process, and fit for the role.

title: Sales & Administrative Assistant
description:
About MiHi



At MiHi Entertainment, we don’t do lame parties. We create photo, video, AI, and interactive experiences for corporate events, trade shows, weddings, and private celebrations across Colorado and nationwide. We’re looking for an organized, confident communicator to help our sales team connect with prospects, respond to leads, and keep the details on track.





The Role



This role combines appointment setting, sales support, and administrative work. You’ll cold-call contacts to schedule meetings for our sales team, respond to inquiries, maintain our CRM, and prepare sales reports. You should enjoy talking with people, working with details, and following through without constant reminders.





What You’ll Do



*Cold-call prospective clients, venues, and partners to introduce MiHi and schedule meetings for the sales team.

*Respond promptly and professionally to incoming leads, gather event details, and coordinate next steps.

*Enter events and client information into DJEP, our CRM, and keep records accurate and up to date.

*Build and maintain sales reports tracking outreach, appointments, lead activity, and bookings.

*Follow up with clients after events to gather feedback, request reviews, and identify future opportunities.

*Schedule meetings, maintain follow-up reminders, and help the sales team stay organized.

*Complete data entry, document preparation, and other administrative tasks as needed.





What We’re Looking For:



*Fluent spoken and written English. We are specifically seeking an American or British accent for client-facing calls.

*A confident, professional phone presence and comfort making cold calls every day.

*Experience in administrative support, appointment setting, customer service, or sales support.

*Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.

*Proficiency with Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, and experience working in a CRM.

*Ability to prepare accurate reports, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with the team.

*Reliable internet, a computer, a headset, and a quiet environment suitable for client calls.

*Availability to work agreed-upon hours that overlap with U.S. business hours.

*We require that you work only for MiHi during your employment here.





Preferred Experience:



*Outbound calling or appointment setting for a U.S.-based business.

*Event, hospitality, or entertainment industry experience.

*Strong AI experience creating automations and analyzing data





Compensation & Schedule:



Pay: $7 USD per hour. 40 hours per week

Bonuses determined based on sales performance

Location: Remote.

Schedule: Agreed-upon hours with availability during U.S. business hours.





How to Apply:



To apply,
 the following to 



• Your resume

• A brief introduction video introducing yourself and explaining your experience with cold calling, appointment setting, and administrative support

• A voice recording of yourself reading the script below, will verify the voice quality during the interview:

“Hi there! This message is for Sweetie. This is Sara, and I’m calling from MiHi Entertainment to chat with you about the Rosie the Robot Photo Booth experience you inquired about for your holiday party in December. I’d love to find a time to connect and discuss the details of your event to see if we’d be a good fit. My phone number is
. You can call or text that number, or feel free to respond to the
 I sent over yesterday. Either way, I look forward to connecting with you soon!”



We’ll use the voice recording to assess your communication style, clarity, confidence, and accent. 



Failure to follow the application instructions will result in disqualification.



MiHi Entertainment is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Amazon Account Manager (Europe) – Listings, PPC & Growth
description:
About us

Skycases is a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce brand selling suitcases and travel accessories. We sell on 
 (the largest marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium) and on Amazon Germany. In 2027 we want to grow Amazon significantly and expand to Amazon Netherlands, Belgium and France. We are a small, ambitious team of two founders and we work with an AI agent that helps with data analysis and content.

The role

You will own our Amazon business in Europe from A to Z: listings, advertising, reviews, account health and expansion to new marketplaces. You take over the work currently done by an external agency, so you need to be able to work independently from day one. You report directly to the founders.

What you will do

- Manage and grow our Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display): keyword research, bid optimization, budget control and weekly ACoS / TACoS reporting

- Create and optimize product listings: titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, A+ content and Brand Store

- Brief our designer for images and infographics and test what converts best

- Launch new products: listing setup, launch strategy and initial advertising

- Expand our catalogue to Amazon NL, BE and FR (listings, translations with AI, advertising setup)

- Monitor reviews and ratings, and use Amazon's own programs (Vine, Request a Review) to collect honest reviews

- Keep our account healthy: compliance, product safety documents, policy warnings, suppressed listings and cases with Seller Support

- Manage Brand Registry and protect our listings against hijackers and wrong edits

- Plan deals and promotions (Lightning Deals, coupons, Prime Day, Black Friday)

- Monitor competitors, pricing and Buy Box, and suggest improvements

- Forecast Amazon sales per product and share this with our supply chain specialist so we never run out of stock

What we are looking for

- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts, ideally in Europe (
 or other EU marketplaces)

- Proven results with Amazon PPC: you can show campaigns you grew profitably

- Strong knowledge of listing optimization, A+ content and Brand Registry

- Experience with EU compliance (GPSR, product safety, VAT/marketplace rules) is a big plus

- Experience with tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout or Data Dive is a plus

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research, content and translations

- Very good written English; German is a plus

- Data-driven, independent and proactive

- Stable internet connection and a quiet place to work

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours with Central European Time (CET) working hours

What we offer

- Long-term, full-time remote position

- Full ownership of a growing Amazon business across multiple EU marketplaces

- Direct contact with the founders

- Performance bonus based on Amazon growth

- Paid time off for Philippine holidays

How to apply

Start your application with the word "SKYCASES" so we know you read this post. Tell us which Amazon marketplaces you have managed, your typical monthly ad spend and one result you are proud of (for example ACoS or sales growth). Applications without this will not be considered.

title: Detail-Obsessed QA Assistant for Weekly Business Reports (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
Job Title: Detail-Obsessed QA Assistant for Weekly Business Reports (Part-Time, Remote)

Type: Part-time, ~10 hours per week to start · Start: within 1–2 weeks



About the role

Dimona Business Systems (Arizona, USA) sells a weekly Competitor Intel Brief to local businesses — a one-page report showing a business owner what their five closest competitors are doing: prices, promotions, reviews, ads. An AI bot builds each brief from public sources. Your job is to make sure every brief is TRUE before it goes out.



This is a quality-control role, not sales or marketing. Same cycle every week: check the bot's work, fix what is wrong, send it for approval,
 it out. The system works because the steps never change — and the work is steady: same window, same hours, every week.



Your schedule: Our week runs on Arizona (USA) time, which is 15 hours behind Philippines time. The main work lands Monday morning Arizona time — late Monday night Philippines time, about 11 PM to 2 AM. You must be reliably available in that window every week.



What you will do

• Read each brief (about 20 minutes each) and verify every number against the live source: Google ratings, review counts, prices, promo pages, social media posts

• Catch the AI's mistakes: invented numbers, outdated prices, wrong competitors, reports about the wrong business

• Tell the bot exactly what to fix, in plain words, and re-check the fix

•
 finished briefs using our exact scripts — no freelancing on the wording

• Follow the checklist the same way every time. Boring is good. Boring means it worked.



What we are looking for

• You notice small errors other people walk past

• You write clear, plain English

• You are honest about what you could NOT verify instead of guessing

• You follow instructions exactly as written



You do NOT need: marketing experience, sales skills, or a degree. We train you on the tools. We cannot train "notices details" — you either have it or you don't.



How to apply

The first line of your application must be: VERIFY FIRST (applications without it are not read — this is your first test).

Then tell us, in a few sentences: who you are, where in the Philippines you are based, and confirm you can work the late-Monday-night window every week.



Shortlisted applicants get a short unpaid test: a sample brief with planted errors. Find them. If you want the job, you'll do the test. Most people miss some — that's the point.

title: Experienced Construction Lien Specialist VA – California Mechanics' Liens
description:
We are a California-based roofing company looking for an experienced Filipino Construction Lien Specialist VA who can independently handle the entire California construction lien process, from Preliminary 20-Day Notices (Pre-Liens) to Mechanics' Liens and lien releases.



**The work includes:**

- Preparing and processing California Preliminary 20-Day Notices.

- Preparing Mechanics' Lien documents and coordinating county recording.

- Managing lien filing deadlines and compliance requirements.

- Preparing Proofs of Service, lien waivers, and lien releases.

- Reviewing contracts, invoices, payment records, and outstanding balances.

- Coordinating with county recorder offices, lien service providers, attorneys, and our internal team.

- Tracking lien status, following up on pending filings, and maintaining accurate records.



We need someone with **at least 2 years of hands-on experience handling California construction liens**, preferably for a U.S. roofing or construction company.



**This is not an entry-level position.** Applicants must already understand California pre-lien and mechanics' lien procedures and be able to work independently with minimal supervision. Legal matters requiring attorney involvement will be referred to authorized counsel.

title: Website Coordinator
description:
Anne Vaughan Designs is hiring a remote, part-time Website Coordinator to keep our Shopify store accurate, current and easy to find. Items in [brackets] are for you to fill in before posting.



About us



Anne Vaughan Designs (AVD) is a jewelry company selling direct to customers and through wholesale. Our website is where customers meet the collections, so the details on every page matter.



The role



You will make the website changes the team requests, working from clear written instructions. The role is about careful, accurate execution and communication. It is not about design or strategy. You will report to [name/title].

What you'll do

• Create and update product listings: titles, descriptions, prices, variants, images and alt text.

• Update collections and navigation when new pieces launch or sell out.

• Edit SEO fields (page titles, meta descriptions, URL handles) using spreadsheets and CSV imports and appropriate apps as defined.

• Update homepage banners, promotions and announcement bars on a set schedule.

• Check every change on desktop and mobile, and fix broken links, missing images and formatting errors.

• Keep a simple log of what you changed and when.

• Flag missing assets, unclear instructions or conflicts early, before they hold up a launch.



What we're looking for



• Hands-on experience managing a Shopify store (products, collections, CSV import/export).

• Strong attention to detail and a habit of double-checking your work.

• Clear written English and prompt replies.

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and Drive. We also use Notion for task tracking.

• Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable asking questions when instructions aren't clear.



Nice to have: basic SEO knowledge, light image editing (resizing, cropping, compressing), and experience with jewelry or e-commerce.



How we work



• Hours: about 10 hours per week, flexible, with 8-10 am Eastern Time available for overlap each Monday-Friday.

• Communication: Notion and Gmail. Product updates are contained within a Google Sheet, and assets for imagery are contained on Google Drive. Visual updates to the homepage, and other non-product update tasks are communicated through Notion.

• Deadlines: you confirm receipt within one business day and tell us at least two business days ahead if something will be late.

• Time tracking: Timeproof or equivalent with weekly hours submitted.

• Confidentiality: you will sign a confidentiality agreement before getting store access. You will have limited-permission access to the Shopify admin, not owner access.



Compensation and terms



• Pay: $5-7 per hour in USD, paid every two weeks via Payoneer or equivalent.

• Contract: independent contractor, starting with a 30-day paid trial.



How to apply



Send a short note with your Shopify experience and availability, plus a minimum of one example of store work you've done. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task: updating five product listings from a spreadsheet and following our written instructions.

title: Remote Pharmacist – Pharmacy Consulting
description:
About the Role



We provide pharmacy consulting services to ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) and are looking for a licensed pharmacist with hospital or clinical pharmacy experience to join our team remotely.



We are a small, close-knit company and are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our team. This is not intended to be a short-term or temporary position.



Who We're Looking For



We are specifically looking for a pharmacist who has worked in a hospital, surgery center, or similar clinical pharmacy setting and is familiar with medication management, pharmacy standards, and healthcare compliance.



Experience with quality assurance, regulatory compliance, auditing, accreditation, medication safety, or pharmacy inspections is especially helpful.



You do not need previous experience specifically as an ASC pharmacy consultant. We are looking for someone who already has a strong pharmacy background and understands how medications are handled in a clinical setting. We can teach the specifics of our consulting process.



Responsibilities



* Research pharmacy and healthcare regulations, guidelines, and updates

* Assist with ASC pharmacy compliance and quality assurance

* Review and organize pharmacy-related reports and documentation

* Help track facility requirements, inspections, and outstanding items

* Follow up on schedules, reports, documentation, and payments

* Assist our consulting pharmacist with research and administrative work

* Help maintain organized records for the facilities we service



What We're Looking For



You should be:



* A pharmacist with hospital, surgery center, or clinical pharmacy experience

* Familiar with medication storage, handling, documentation, and pharmacy practices

* Organized and highly detail-oriented

* Comfortable researching healthcare regulations and guidelines online

* Able to work independently and follow through on assignments

* Interested in compliance, quality assurance, and the operational side of pharmacy

* Looking for a stable, long-term position with a small team



How to Apply



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

First, tell us a little about yourself and what you like to do for fun. Then tell us about your experience as a pharmacist, including any experience you have in hospitals, surgery centers, clinical pharmacy, quality assurance, compliance, auditing, accreditation, medication safety, or similar work.

You are the all-round e-commerce specialist of our team. You make sure customers are happy, our listings convert, and we know what will sell next. You combine customer service, content, design and data, and you use AI every day to work faster. You report directly to the founders.

What you will do

Customer service

- Handle customer service on all channels (
, Amazon and
): review, correct and send the reply drafts written by our AI agent, and handle complex cases yourself

- Improve our customer service setup: better AI prompts, templates and FAQ answers

- Ask customers for honest reviews after their purchase, using the official tools of 
 and Amazon (such as Amazon's "Request a Review"), and monitor and respond to reviews

Listings and content

- Optimize product listings on 
 and Amazon: titles, descriptions, bullet points, specifications and keywords

- Create and improve infographics and product images (Canva, Photoshop or similar, with help from AI)

- Run A/B tests on images, titles and content, measure the results and roll out the winners

Forecasting and analysis

- Make sales forecasts per product (SKU) based on sales history, seasonality and trends, and share them with our supply chain specialist

- Build analyses and reports: sales, conversion, returns, reviews and profit per product

- Analyze returns and customer complaints every month and suggest improvements to products, packaging and listings

What we are looking for

- 2+ years of experience in e-commerce, ideally for an Amazon or marketplace seller

- Experience with customer service as well as listing optimization

- Good design skills with Canva, Photoshop or similar: please include examples of infographics or product images you made

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (formulas, pivot tables, basic forecasting)

- Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, AI image tools) and curious to automate your own work

- Very good written English; Dutch or German is a big plus (most of our customers write in Dutch or German, AI helps you translate)

- Precise, structured and proactive

- Stable internet connection and a quiet place to work

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours with Central European Time (CET) working hours

What we offer

- Long-term, full-time remote position

- A varied role with a lot of ownership and direct contact with the founders

- Room to grow as the company scales towards millions in revenue

- Paid time off for Philippine holidays

How to apply

Start your application with the word "SKYCASES" so we know you read this post. Tell us briefly about your e-commerce experience and include 2 or 3 examples of infographics or product images you made. Applications without this will not be considered.

title: Dental Virtual Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING!



Remote Dental Insurance Verification & Billing Specialist (Part-Time)



Company: Platonics LLC

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Part-Time

Work Schedule: 20 Hours Per Week

Time Zone: US Central Time (CST)



About the Opportunity



Platonics LLC is currently looking for a highly experienced Dental Insurance Verification & Billing Specialist to support one of our US-based dental healthcare clients.



We are seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and experienced professional who has extensive hands-on knowledge of US dental insurance verification, benefits breakdown, claims follow-up, and insurance payment posting.



This position is strictly for applicants with relevant US dental insurance and billing experience.



The ideal candidate must be capable of working independently, following established procedures, and delivering accurate results with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Dental Insurance Verification & Benefits Breakdown



Verify patients' dental insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits at least two days before scheduled appointments.



Review deductibles, annual maximums, coverage percentages, frequency limitations, waiting periods, exclusions, and other plan restrictions.



Prepare complete and accurate insurance benefit breakdowns using established templates.



Document verified insurance benefits in the dental practice management system.



Ensure insurance information is accurate and updated when changes occur.



Identify and escalate missing, incomplete, or conflicting insurance information.



2. Dental Insurance Claims Follow-Up



Monitor and track dental insurance claims and their payment status.



Follow up on outstanding, unpaid, denied, and aged insurance claims.



Document all follow-up activities accurately.



Identify claims requiring additional documentation, corrections, or escalation.



Coordinate with appropriate team members to help resolve outstanding insurance receivables.



3. Insurance Payment Posting & Patient Statements



Post electronic insurance payments (EFT) accurately to patient accounts.



Review electronic Explanations of Benefits (EOBs).



Verify insurance payments, adjustments, contractual write-offs, and remaining patient balances.



Review and validate contracted dental fee schedules.



Identify discrepancies in reimbursement amounts, payment calculations, and contractual adjustments.



Report unusual reimbursement patterns or suspected fee schedule changes.



Assist with patient balance reviews and statement preparation.



Escalate account discrepancies requiring further investigation.



4. Administrative Accuracy & HIPAA Compliance



Maintain complete and accurate records within the dental practice management system.



Follow established procedures for insurance verification, claims follow-up, and payment posting.



Ensure all patient information is handled securely and in accordance with HIPAA regulations.



Communicate unresolved issues and discrepancies promptly.



Support additional dental insurance and revenue cycle administrative responsibilities as assigned.



Minimum Qualifications — Strictly Required



Applicants MUST meet the following qualifications:



At least 2 years of relevant hands-on experience in US dental insurance verification, dental billing, insurance payment posting, or dental revenue cycle management.



Strong knowledge of US dental insurance plans, eligibility verification, benefits breakdowns, deductibles, annual maximums, and coverage limitations.



Proven experience reviewing EOBs and posting dental insurance payments.



Experience handling aged dental claims, insurance follow-ups, and outstanding balances.



Strong understanding of dental insurance fee schedules, contractual adjustments, and reimbursement discrepancies.



Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Ability to follow established workflows, templates, and procedures.



Must possess a valid HIPAA certification.



Must be available to work 20 hours per week aligned with US Central Time.



Required Software Knowledge



Candidates must have familiarity with or relevant working experience using the following platforms:



Eaglesoft — Dental Practice Management System



Practice by Numbers (PBN) — Patient Communication and Practice Analytics



Vyne Trellis — Dental Revenue Cycle and Insurance Management Platform



Hands-on experience with these systems will be a strong advantage.



Work Schedule



Employment Type: Part-Time



Total Working Hours: 20 hours per week



Work Location: Remote / Work From Home



Time Zone: US Central Time



Schedule: To be finalized based on operational requirements



IMPORTANT NOTICE TO ALL APPLICANTS



WE WILL STRICTLY ENTERTAIN QUALIFIED APPLICANTS ONLY.



This position requires actual, relevant experience in US dental insurance verification, dental billing, and revenue cycle operations.



Please carefully review the qualifications before submitting your application.



We will NOT entertain or process applications from candidates who do not meet the minimum qualifications.



Applicants without the required dental insurance or billing experience are strongly discouraged from applying.



Experience in general customer service, virtual assistance, medical billing unrelated to dental operations, or other administrative roles does not automatically qualify an applicant for this position.



Only shortlisted candidates whose experience closely matches the requirements will be contacted for the next stage of recruitment.



How to Apply



Interested and qualified applicants are encouraged to submit their updated resume highlighting their relevant experience in:



US Dental Insurance Verification and Benefits Breakdown



Dental Insurance Claims Follow-Up



Insurance Payment Posting and EOB Review



Dental Practice Management Software



US Dental Revenue Cycle Management



Please indicate your years of relevant experience and the dental software platforms you have used.



Join Platonics LLC and become part of a growing team of healthcare professionals supporting US-based dental practices!



Platonics LLC

Connecting Exceptional Talent With Meaningful Opportunities.

title: Senior Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller – Australian Projects
description:
Senior Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller – Australian Projects



Employment: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Salary: AUD $1,000–$2,000 per month, negotiable based on experience

₱44,915.70 to ₱89,831.40 PHP per month



About Us



Construction company specialising in structural steel supply, fabrication, installation and structural alterations across residential, commercial and industrial projects.



We are looking for an experienced and reliable Structural Steel Detailer / Tekla Modeller to join our team on a long-term basis.



This is an opportunity to work directly with an Australian construction company, with potential for career progression, increased responsibilities, salary reviews and promotion as the business expands.



We are seeking someone who can work independently, understand Australian engineering requirements and deliver accurate, practical drawings suitable for fabrication and installation.



Key Responsibilities



1. Structural Steel Detailing & Shop Drawings



Develop accurate 3D structural steel models using Tekla Structures.



Prepare complete fabrication shop drawings, assembly drawings, single-part drawings and erection/marking plans.



Detail steel connections including base plates, cleats, stiffeners, bolted connections and welds in accordance with approved engineering documentation.



Prepare fabrication-ready drawings, cutting lists, material schedules and NC/DXF files where required.



Review architectural and structural engineering drawings to identify clashes, discrepancies and missing information.



Prepare RFIs and coordinate drawing revisions.



Understand fabrication processes, installation sequencing, site tolerances and constructability.



Assist with design development and detailing solutions, subject to structural engineer review and approval where required.



2. Structural Steel Material Take-Offs



Independently review structural and architectural drawing packages.



Identify the complete structural steel scope of works.



Prepare accurate material take-offs including UB, UC, PFC, RHS, SHS, CHS, angles, plates and other structural steel members.



Calculate member quantities, lengths, linear metres, unit weights and total steel tonnage.



Identify associated connection materials, plates, cleats and other fabrication requirements.



Prepare organised Excel material schedules suitable for supplier enquiries and project pricing.



Clearly identify exclusions, assumptions and missing information.



3. Estimating & Pricing – Future Development Opportunity



As the successful candidate becomes familiar with our business and demonstrates strong technical capability, we would like to expand their responsibilities into:



Preparing structural steel estimates using our company pricing schedules.



Assisting with fabrication, coatings, delivery and installation allowances.



Preparing professional client pricing proposals using MIREK templates.



Assisting with tender submissions and project cost breakdowns.



Previous estimating experience will be highly regarded but is not essential. Our immediate priority is structural steel detailing, shop drawings and accurate material take-offs.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 5 years' professional experience in structural steel detailing, preferably 7+ years.



Advanced proficiency in Tekla Structures.



Must have their own legitimate, active Tekla Structures licence and software access suitable for commercial steel detailing work.



Proven experience producing fabrication shop drawings for Australian structural steel projects.



Strong understanding of Australian Standards, including AS 4100 and AS/NZS 5131, as applicable to the role.



Ability to interpret structural engineering and architectural drawings independently.



Sound understanding of structural steel connections, fabrication requirements and installation methods.



Ability to prepare accurate material take-offs and Excel schedules.



Excellent attention to detail, communication and time management.



Reliable computer, internet connection and ability to work remotely.



Career Development & Promotion



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term career with MIREK Construction.



The successful candidate will initially focus on steel detailing, shop drawings and material take-offs.



As our business grows, there will be opportunities to progress into a Senior Detailer, Estimator or Detailing Team Leader position, with increased responsibilities and salary reviews based on performance.



Our long-term objective is to build a dedicated detailing and estimating department, and we would like the right person to grow with us.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your CV and years of structural steel detailing experience.



Examples of previous Tekla models and fabrication shop drawings, preferably from Australian projects.



An example of a structural steel material take-off or Excel material schedule.



Confirmation that you have your own licensed Tekla Structures software.



Details of your experience working with Australian Standards and fabrication requirements.



Your expected monthly salary in AUD.



Your availability to commence employment.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and a paid technical assessment.



Important: Applications without evidence of previous Tekla shop drawing experience will not be considered.



We look forward to finding the right person to join our team.

Work toward individual and company performance goals tied to closed and funded transactions

Strong verbal and written communication skills

title: Children's Content Creator (AI Video / Image / Music / Editing)
description:
Type: Remote, Part-Time (with potential to grow into Full-Time)

Pay: $3-$5 an hour

About the Role

We're building a new children's entertainment brand — calm, low-stimulation animated content for very

young audiences (ages 0–5), released on YouTube. We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented team

member to help produce content using a hybrid AI-assisted workflow.



You'll be working across two types of content:

• Animated character songs — short, character-driven music videos (around 2–4 minutes) that

introduce our characters and their worlds. Over time, the songs and characters that connect most

with our audience will be expanded into long-form animated stories.

• Bedtime lullaby visualisers — long-form videos (30+ minutes) built from gentle AI-generated

animated loops paired with original generated music, designed to play while children wind down

and fall asleep.



This is an early-stage project with real growth potential — you'll be part of shaping a brand from the

ground up, not just executing a fixed process.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Generating animated video clips for character-driven songs using AI video generation tools

(training provided on our specific platform/workflow)

• Creating seamless, slow-moving animated loops for long-form bedtime videos, making sure each

loop's first and last frame match cleanly

• Creating character reference sheets and scene images using AI image generation tools (e.g.,

Gemini, and other image generators)

• Creating children's music using Suno, following our style and subject guidelines — for both

character songs and bedtime music

• Assembling and lightly editing finished videos in CapCut (trimming, syncing audio, slow

crossfades, basic transitions)

• Following provided prompt templates and style guides to keep characters, backgrounds and art

style consistent from shot to shot

• Flagging inconsistencies (visual glitches, mismatched scenes, pacing issues) before content is

finalised



What We're Looking For

Experience with one or more of the following is preferred (you don't need all three):

◦ AI video generation tools (e.g., Vidu, Runway, Kling, or similar)

◦ AI image generation tools (e.g., Gemini, or other image generators)

◦ Suno or other AI music generation tools



Skills you need:

◦ Basic video editing in CapCut

• Strong attention to visual detail — you'll need to spot subtle inconsistencies between generated

frames/clips (lighting, object placement, character appearance) that can cause visual glitches

when stitched together

• Comfortable working from templates and style guides while still using independent judgement to

solve problems

• Strong written English, since some tasks may involve writing or adjusting lyrics, narration or

script wording for a young children's audience — the ability to judge whether phrasing is simple

and natural enough for toddlers is important

• Patience for detail-heavy, repetitive work — long-form bedtime content involves building and

checking many loops against a shared style sheet

• Reliable daily availability, as our workflow depends on consistent, near-daily content generation

• Interest in children's content specifically — an intuitive sense for what's calming, engaging, and

age-appropriate for very young viewers is a big plus



Nice to Have

• Prior experience creating content for a children's audience

• Familiarity with low-stimulation / calm-paced content styles (think gentle pacing, longer shots,

muted colour palettes)

• Experience creating seamless looping animation or video

• An interest in storytelling and character development, as our songs will grow into longer

animated stories

• Any portfolio or examples of past creative work, even informal



How to Apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction (who you are, relevant experience)

2. Any examples of past work (Ai video generation prefferably)

3. Your availability (hours/days per week)



We're excited to build something meaningful for young audiences, and we're looking for someone who

wants to grow with the project.

description:
About us

Skycases is a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce brand selling suitcases and travel accessories on 
 (the largest marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium) and Amazon Germany. Our products are manufactured in China, shipped by container to the Netherlands and stored at a fulfillment warehouse. In 2027 we plan to ship around 100 containers (about 2 per week) and process roughly 80,000 orders. We are a small, ambitious team of three founders and we work closely with an AI agent that connects to our sales, stock and logistics data.



The role

You will own the day-to-day supply chain and operations: making sure the right products are ordered, shipped and in stock at the right time, and that everything around it runs smoothly. You report directly to the founders. Final purchasing decisions are approved by the founders, but you prepare them.

What we are looking for

- 3+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory planning, purchasing or logistics, ideally for an e-commerce or Amazon business

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (formulas, pivot tables, forecasting)

- Very good written English

- Precise, structured and proactive: you notice when numbers don't add up

- Experience with importing from China, containers (FCL) or a 3PL warehouse is a big plus

What we offer

I. About Us



We are a matcha import and wholesale company based in New York, USA. Our client base includes independent coffee shops, regional coffee chains, and large-scale coffee chains across the United States.



As our business in the U.S. market continues to grow, we are looking to hire 3 part-time sales representatives who are fluent in English and have experience in telesales. Using a provided list of potential leads, you will proactively reach out to coffee shops across the U.S. to introduce our matcha products, convert prospects into active purchasing clients, and establish long-term, stable business relationships.



II. Position Details

Position Type: Part-time, approximately 7 hours per day

Working Hours: Monday through Saturday, scheduled according to Eastern Standard Time (EST)

Base Pay: $5 USD per hour

Commission: $10 USD for every new client successfully acquired. A sale is considered valid only once the client has completed their payment.

Commission Potential: Each representative will be assigned approximately 3,334 potential leads. If all are successfully converted into paying clients, an individual could earn up to $33,340 USD in commissions.

III. Responsibilities



The company will provide a comprehensive list of potential leads; you do not need to source your own prospects—simply conduct outreach based on the provided list. You will contact coffee shops across the U.S. using the company’s Zoom Phone system and log the details of every call into our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. 1. Client Acquisition via Telephone



Proactively call coffee shops across the United States based on a provided list.

Introduce the company’s matcha products to shop owners, managers, or purchasing decision-makers.

Inquire about the client’s current matcha procurement status and potential needs.

Highlight product advantages and secure the client’s interest in a potential partnership.



2. Client Follow-up



Follow up with interested prospects via text message to nurture the relationship.

Promptly address client inquiries regarding products, samples, pricing, quality, and procurement processes.

Coordinate the shipment of samples and facilitate the placement of initial orders based on client interest.



3. Sample Management and Client Relations



Since matcha is a product that requires a hands-on experience, many coffee shops prefer to test samples before deciding to incorporate them into their daily beverage offerings. Therefore, your responsibilities also include:



Following up with clients who have received samples.

Gathering feedback on the product through phone calls and text messages.

Addressing initial questions to encourage the client to make their first purchase.

Maintaining strong, ongoing communication with interested prospects.



4. Client Data and Sales Record Management



Log every call using the company’s designated CRM system.

Accurately record client interest levels, call outcomes, and follow-up plans.

Manage client lists using Google Sheets in coordination with company protocols.

Ensure that all client data and sales records are kept up to date.



IV. Job Requirements



We place a high value on strong English communication skills and professional stability; please review these requirements carefully. 1. Spoken English (Most Important)



Fluent spoken English with clear, natural pronunciation; your communication style should be comparable to that of a native speaker in a U.S. business context.

Strong listening skills, with the ability to understand various accents and speaking styles from clients across different regions.

Capable of independently conducting product presentations, client communications, and sales conversations.

Able to engage naturally with coffee shop owners and managers, ensuring a professional and seamless interaction.



2. Work Experience



At least 1 year of experience in outbound calling, call center operations, or appointment scheduling.

Prior experience in U.S. market telesales, retail product promotion in the U.S., or B2B sales is highly preferred.

Experience in developing U.S. corporate/business clients is a plus.



3. Equipment and Internet



A quiet, private home-office environment.

High-quality noise-canceling headphones or a professional-grade headset.

A stable, high-speed internet connection, with a backup option (such as mobile data or a secondary internet service) to ensure no interruptions during work hours.

Proficiency in using Zoom Phone, Google Sheets, and standard office software.



4. Work Ethic



Conscientious, responsible, punctual, and highly professional.

Able to log in on time as scheduled and consistently carry out daily outreach calls and client follow-ups.

Strong self-management skills and a clear focus on achieving sales targets.



5. Confidentiality Requirements



You will have access to sensitive business information, including lists of potential clients, contact details, and sales records. All new hires are required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and must strictly adhere to the company’s policies regarding the protection of client information.



V. How to Apply: A Self-Recorded Video Is Mandatory



Applications submitted without a video will be automatically rejected—no exceptions.



Please record a video of yourself that includes the following:



A brief overview of your telesales experience and your available working hours (please specify your time zone).

An explanation of why you would like to join our team.

A 60-second telesales simulation: Imagine you are calling a U.S. coffee shop; introduce yourself and our company’s matcha products to the owner or manager in a natural, engaging way, and attempt to spark their interest.



We will specifically evaluate your English fluency, pronunciation, tone, natural delivery, and overall effectiveness in telesales communication. Submission Steps:
