title: CAD Senior Accountant
description:
About the firm



We're a Canadian CPA-led accounting firm helping small-business owners understand their finances, improve their systems and keep more of what they earn.



Our team works together across Edmonton, Manila and Puerto Princesa. We value clear communication, practical solutions and reliable work. 



The role



We're hiring a Senior Accountant to prepare Canadian small-business files from client records through to CPA review. You'll prepare compilation engagements, year-end working papers and tax returns, while helping junior and intermediate accountants develop their skills.



You'll report to our production manager, who coordinates workflow and priorities. This is primarily an internal role, suited to an experienced Canadian public practice accountant who enjoys preparing files, solving problems and supporting colleagues.



What you'll do



Prepare compilation engagement files under CSRS 4200, including year-end working papers and financial statements in CaseWare.

Prepare T2 corporate returns, T1 personal returns, supporting schedules and T-slips for CPA review.

Review QuickBooks Online records for accurate coding, GST/HST treatment and transaction completeness.

Prepare account reconciliations, GST/HST working papers and year-end adjusting entries with clear supporting documentation.

Investigate discrepancies and missing information and flag matters requiring further accounting or tax judgment to our Canadian CPA.

Assist junior and intermediate accountants with technical questions, reconciliations and file preparation, explain corrections and help them apply reviewer feedback.

Respond thoroughly to review notes and apply feedback to future files.

Keep tasks and file status current in Karbon, coordinate priorities with the production manager and flag potential delays early.



What you'll bring



At least five years of accounting experience, including Canadian compilation engagements and corporate and personal tax preparation.

Hands-on CaseWare Working Papers experience and the ability to prepare files through to reviewer submission.

Experience with Canadian tax software. TaxCycle is preferred; ProFile, Taxprep or similar experience is welcome.

Practical knowledge of Canadian corporate and personal tax, GST/HST and T-slips.

Strong QuickBooks Online and Excel skills.

Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain accounting issues and give constructive feedback.

Strong organization and the ability to balance your own deadlines with supporting colleagues.

A quiet home workspace and reliable internet.

Helpful, but not required: Philippine CPA designation or progress toward it; experience training junior accountants; Karbon or Dext experience; QBO ProAdvisor certification; Alberta corporate tax experience.



If you meet most of these requirements and have strong Canadian file-preparation experience, we encourage you to apply.



Schedule and work-life balance



Fully remote, with at least half your working day overlapping Alberta business hours, including availability for team meetings between 1:30 and 3:00 p.m. Alberta time (3:30–5:00 a.m. Philippine time the following day).

Your remaining hours are flexible around agreed deadlines and team coordination. This role requires regular overnight availability in the Philippines.

Corporate year-ends are spread throughout the year, helping distribute the workload. Some periods are busier, but overtime is not a regular expectation.



Compensation and benefits



₱100,000–₱130,000 per month, depending on relevant experience, plus 13th month pay.

Paid public holidays following the firm's Canadian holiday schedule, exchangeable day-for-day for Philippine holidays by prior arrangement.

Company-provided laptop, equipment and peripherals.

Paid professional development.

An annual reimbursed birthday treat.

Mid-year and Christmas virtual team gatherings.

Opportunities to develop your technical and coaching skills.

title: Remote Executive Assistant to Real Estate Founder & CEO
description:
Please read the full posting. Application instructions are at the end.



THE ROLE



Fraser & Co. is a boutique luxury real estate consultancy serving Durham Region and the Greater Toronto Area in Ontario, Canada. It is led by our Founder & CEO, Michelle Fraser, who has 25+ years in the business and still runs an active sales practice.



We are hiring a remote Executive Assistant to run the administrative side of Michelle's business and personal life. Your success is measured by how smoothly her day runs and how much time you free up for her highest-value work.



WHAT MAKES THIS SEAT DIFFERENT



This is founder-led tempo, not a corporate rhythm. Decisions are made fast and priorities shift quickly. The right person finds that energizing.



Requests come through
, WhatsApp, text, and video calls, sometimes with only the desired outcome. You pull the information together, ask the one question that matters, and move with a clear recommendation, separating what is known from what is assumed. When Michelle's plans change, you see what else is affected (clients, meetings, deadlines, travel, personal commitments) and handle it before it becomes a problem.



In return: real trust, owner-level responsibility, candid feedback, and work that matters every day.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Inbox management: own Michelle's inbox and communication flow end-to-end. Triage, draft in her voice under an approval protocol, protect her focus, and escalate only genuine decisions. Every message states what is needed, by when, and what happens next.

• Calendar and meeting readiness: protect selling and focus time, adapt to shifting priorities, catch conflicts early, and prepare every meeting with the background, documents, and decision required.

• Goals and follow-through: document Michelle's commitments, build her weekly goals and quarterly priorities into the schedule, follow up proactively, surface risks early, and close every loop.

• Client database and reminders: keep Michelle's client database clean, complete, and current, and run the reminder system for follow-ups, key dates, and client touchpoints.

• Deal coordination support (as needed): when Michelle needs it, help coordinate contracts, e-signatures, conditions, deadlines, and closing documents with our client care team, lawyers, and advisors.

• Bookkeeping and expense tracking: manage day-to-day bookkeeping across the businesses, including expenses, invoices, and reconciliations. Accountants handle year-end and tax work; your role is making sure they receive complete, accurate books.

• Property portfolio administration: track open legal, accounting, insurance, partnership, property, and corporate matters across multiple entities. Coordinate tenant communications, maintenance and trades scheduling, and vendors for Michelle's rental and commercial properties.

• Personal logistics: manage appointments, renewals, travel, household scheduling, gifts, and key dates, within clear privacy boundaries.

• Executive readiness: coordinate vendors, events, and last-minute execution. When a new initiative comes up, you make it executable quickly, with the right people informed and the calendar protected. You also work with our marketing team to prepare Michelle for photo shoots, video days, seminars, and public appearances.

• First-line tech support: resolve account, app, login, and connectivity issues for Michelle quickly and independently.



HOW WE WORK



Initiative on execution, alignment on direction. Within agreed authority, you d
 how to execute. You confirm alignment before acting on strategy, significant spending, legal risk, or key relationships, and you bring a clear recommendation, not an open-ended question.



Learn before you improve. Our systems reflect 25+ years of experience. You learn them first, execute them reliably, and then help refine them once the foundation is stable.



The first 90 days. You start with core executive support. Broader responsibilities may be added only after that system is stable and any expanded scope is explicitly agreed.



YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON IF



• You thrive supporting a founder who moves quickly.

• You see implications, not just tasks. You ask the question behind the question and anticipate needs before they are voiced.

• You bring recommendations, clarity, and solutions, not open loops.

• You are resilient: steady and composed when things move fast, and quick to reset.

• You are organized enough to absorb complexity and flexible enough to adapt without friction.

• You are curious and improvement-oriented, with a "let's make this work" mindset focused on the team's win.

• You have executive presence: clear, discreet, confident, and service-oriented, and you read the room.

• You communicate in outcomes and protect confidentiality absolutely.

• You want to be part of building something bigger, not just handling the day-to-day.

• You measure your success by the capacity you create for the executive you support.



QUALIFICATIONS



• 5+ years supporting a senior executive or principal, or 3+ years directly supporting a founder, business owner, or sales leader in a similarly intense environment.

• Experience supporting a Canadian or US executive remotely is a strong asset.

• Real estate experience is preferred, not required. We can teach the industry. We cannot teach pace or discretion.

• Exceptional written and spoken English. You will be tested on this during the hiring process.

• Strong systems skills across inboxes, calendars, spreadsheets, digital filing, and fast, accurate document preparation.

• Hands-on bookkeeping ability (QuickBooks, Lone Wolf, or similar): expense tracking, invoices, and reconciliations.

• Strong proficiency with our tools, or the proven ability to learn new platforms quickly with minimal help: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), Zoom, WhatsApp, DocuSign, QuickBooks, Lone Wolf, Follow Up Boss, Sisu, Top Producer, 
 (EOS), Mac and iPhone, and AI tools. This seat is plug-and-play: you arrive ready.

• Advanced technical self-sufficiency: you diagnose and fix technology issues on your own.

• Comfortable managing accounts and logins across business and personal matters with care and discretion.

• Absolute discretion with confidential financial, legal, business, and personal information.

• Experience in a fast-paced, sales-driven environment is a strong asset, ideally supporting a high-producing agent or sales team.

• Post-secondary education is an asset.



REMOTE WORK SETUP



• A reliable computer and a backup device.

• Stable high-speed internet and a backup connection.

• A backup power plan for outages.

• A quiet, private workspace, a noise-cancelling headset, and a webcam.



COMPENSATION AND HOURS



• Starting at US$6/hour, based on experience.

• Full-time, long-term.

• Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Toronto time: 7 paid hours plus a 1-hour unpaid break.

• After-hours and weekend work as needed for time-sensitive matters. This is a real part of the role, and we are upfront about it. Response expectations, coverage, and how additional hours are recognized will be set out in writing before you start.



HOW TO APPLY



We review complete applications only. Following instructions exactly is part of this job. Applications are text only, so send links, not files.



1. Use this subject line: Executive Assistant | Your Full Name | Years Supporting Executives

2. Start your message with the word DISCRETION.

3. Resume (required): paste a link to your resume. Google Drive or Dropbox is fine. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" and check that the link opens.

4. Work samples (optional): paste links to blank templates, trackers, checklists, dashboards or SOPs you built. Do not share anything that shows a client's or employer's names, financial details or personal information.

5. Answer the five questions below in your own words. Label your answers Q1 to Q5 and keep each one to 2 to 4 sentences.



QUESTIONS



Q1. Tell us about the fastest-moving executive, founder or business owner you have supported: their industry and country, the work you handled, and the systems you used, including any bookkeeping software.

Q2. Tell us about a time you noticed something an executive needed before they asked. What did you see, what did you handle yourself, and what was the result?

Q3. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. How was it found, and what did you change afterward?

Q4. What other clients or jobs do you have right now, and how many hours a week do they take?

Q5. Can you work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Toronto time, Monday to Friday, plus after-hours and weekend work as needed? What hourly rate do you expect, and why? What is your earliest start date?





Thank you to everyone who applies. Only selected applicants will be contacted.

Remote

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions VA
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: QuickBooks Expert
description:

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to enter transactions or categorize expenses. We need someone who truly understands the numbers, can perform complex reconciliations, prepare accurate financial statements, and understand how different accounts and financial reports connect.



Key Responsibilities:

- Perform accurate and detailed bank reconciliations.

- Handle credit card reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.

- Prepare and record journal entries.

- Review and maintain accurate general ledger accounts.

- Demonstrate a strong understanding of debits and credits, assets, liabilities, and equity accounts.

- Prepare and analyze financial statements, including:

  - Income Statements (Profit & Loss)

  - Balance Sheets

  - Cash Flow Statements

- Understand how the three financial statements interact and how transactions affect each statement.

- Export financial transactions from QuickBooks and organize, analyze, and work with the data using Excel.

- Use Excel formulas and functions to review financial data, identify discrepancies, and support reporting.

- Strong knowledge of bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Solid understanding of accounting principles, including debits, credits, assets, liabilities, and equity.

- Proven experience preparing and understanding financial statements.

- Ability to explain how the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement relate to one another.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, particularly with formulas, functions, and working with exported financial data.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

- Good written and spoken English communication skills.



What We Are Looking For:

The ideal candidate is someone with a genuine accounting background who can work independently with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable reviewing financial records, identifying errors, understanding the impact of transactions, and ensuring that financial reports are accurate.



QuickBooks expertise is our top priority. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate a deep understanding of the platform and the accounting principles behind the work, not just familiarity with basic bookkeeping functions.

title: Shopify SEO & Product Catalog Specialist – Organic Sales + Ongoing Commissions
description:
Shopify SEO & Product Catalog Specialist – Organic Sales Growth + Ongoing Commissions



Company: EcoRise Supply

Website: 

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Part-Time, 4 Hours Per Day, Monday–Friday (20 Hours/Week)

Compensation: $5 USD/Hour + $5 Per Qualifying Organic Shopify Order



About EcoRise Supply



EcoRise Supply is a growing U.S.-based ecommerce business selling products across multiple categories, including automotive parts and accessories.



We are currently undergoing a major expansion of our Shopify store, with plans to add over 150,000 automotive products.



We are looking for an experienced Shopify SEO & Product Catalog Specialist who will be directly responsible for uploading these products, managing and improving our catalog, optimizing our website for search engines, and helping generate consistent daily sales.



Many of our products have incomplete descriptions, missing images, or limited product information. We need someone who knows how to efficiently manage large-scale product uploads, enrich product information, and create professional, SEO-optimized listings.



Our primary goal is to grow Shopify sales through organic search without relying on paid advertising.



We are not looking for someone who simply tells us what improvements need to be made. We want someone who can independently develop strategies, implement solutions, and take ownership of the work.



Key Responsibilities



Shopify Product Uploads & Catalog Management



Personally manage and execute bulk uploads of 150,000+ automotive products into Shopify.



Prepare, organize, clean, and manage product data using CSV files, spreadsheets, and Shopify bulk import tools.



Improve product titles, descriptions, images, specifications, and other listing information.



Research and source missing product information and images from reliable manufacturer or authorized data sources.



Ensure products are accurately categorized and organized into appropriate Shopify collections.



Verify product information, SKUs, pricing, inventory fields, and other important listing details.



Identify and correct duplicate listings, incomplete product information, import errors, and catalog inconsistencies.



Develop efficient workflows to upload and optimize thousands of products without manually editing each listing.



Maintain professional, consistent, and SEO-friendly product listings across the entire catalog.



SEO & Organic Sales Growth



Develop and execute an SEO strategy focused on increasing organic traffic, conversions, and sales.



Optimize Shopify product pages, collection pages, titles, descriptions, meta titles, and meta descriptions.



Conduct keyword research targeting customers with strong purchase intent.



Identify and resolve technical SEO issues affecting Google indexing and organic visibility.



Work with Google Search Console, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, and structured data.



Improve website architecture, internal linking, and collection organization.



Identify opportunities to increase organic rankings for relevant automotive products and categories.



Monitor organic search performance and implement improvements based on results.



Focus on attracting customers who are actively searching for products they intend to purchase.



Shopify Website Optimization



Identify opportunities to improve Shopify website design, navigation, and overall user experience.



Improve website loading speeds, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals.



Optimize collection pages and product page layouts to improve conversions.



Identify technical or usability problems that could prevent customers from completing purchases.



Recommend and implement practical improvements that contribute to long-term organic sales growth.



Reporting & Performance



Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, Google indexing, conversions, and revenue.



Provide regular updates on completed work, challenges, and measurable progress.



Set realistic priorities and consistently work toward increasing profitable organic sales.



Take initiative in identifying problems and implementing solutions.



Requirements



Proven professional experience with Shopify and ecommerce SEO.



Hands-on experience uploading and managing products through Shopify.



Strong experience with CSV files, spreadsheets, bulk product editing, and product data management.



Experience optimizing large ecommerce product catalogs.



Demonstrated success improving organic search visibility, traffic, or ecommerce revenue.



Strong understanding of technical SEO, Google indexing, and Google Search Console.



Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.



Strong understanding of product page SEO, collection page optimization, and keyword research.



Ability to research product information accurately and efficiently.



Familiarity with Shopify themes, website performance, and conversion optimization.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take initiative.



Reliable internet connection and consistent availability.



We strongly prefer applicants who can demonstrate measurable results from previous Shopify or ecommerce SEO projects.



Experience working with automotive parts and accessories is a plus, but not required.



Compensation & Growth Opportunities



Starting Pay: $5 USD Per Hour



The position begins at 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday, totaling 20 hours per week.



Ongoing Sales Commission: $5 Per Qualifying Organic Shopify Order



In addition to hourly compensation, you will earn $5 for each qualifying organic Shopify order under our commission program.



This is an ongoing commission opportunity, not a temporary introductory bonus. Eligible commissions can continue throughout your employment while the commission program remains in effect.



Commissions apply only to qualifying, profitable orders generated through organic traffic, without paid advertising.



Cancelled, refunded, and returned orders do not qualify for commission. Commissions will be reconciled monthly, with applicable adjustments for returns and refunds.



Full commission eligibility, attribution, and payment terms will be provided before employment begins.



Your earning potential grows as the store grows.



For example, if the Shopify store generates 1,000 qualifying organic orders in a month, you could earn $5,000 in commissions alone, in addition to your hourly pay.



This is an illustrative example, not a guarantee of future sales or earnings. Actual commissions depend on qualifying orders and the terms of the commission program.



We want someone who is motivated to help build a successful ecommerce business and benefit financially from the results.



Opportunity to Increase Hours



This position starts part-time, but we are looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity.



As our Shopify store grows and you demonstrate strong performance, there may be opportunities to increase your working hours and eventually transition to full-time.



Additional hours will depend on demonstrated results, progress toward our business goals, and operational needs.



We value individuals who take ownership of their work, consistently deliver results, and are motivated to grow alongside the business.



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



Has real experience working with Shopify and ecommerce SEO.



Can independently manage large-scale product uploads and catalog improvements.



Understands how to optimize product listings efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



Knows how to improve Google indexing and organic search visibility.



Understands that generating profitable sales is more important than simply increasing website traffic.



Can identify opportunities and take action without constant supervision.



Is ambitious, entrepreneurial, and motivated by performance-based earnings.



Is interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing with the company.



We are looking for someone who can both develop the strategy and personally execute the work.



How to Apply



All interested applicants must complete our official application form:







The application includes questions about your Shopify experience, technical SEO knowledge, bulk product management, previous results, availability, and compensation expectations.



Please provide detailed, truthful answers based on your actual professional experience.



Applications submitted without completing the application form will not be considered.



Attention to Detail



To confirm you have read the entire job posting, remember the keyword BANANA.



You will be asked to provide this keyword in the application form.



Build Something Bigger With Us



We're looking for someone who wants to take not only EcoRise Supply to the next level, but also their own career and earning potential.



This is more than a traditional hourly position. It's an opportunity to help build and grow a successful ecommerce business while directly benefiting from the results you achieve.



With an ongoing $5 commission per qualifying organic order, your potential earnings can grow significantly as our Shopify store expands.



We're looking for someone ambitious, entrepreneurial, and motivated to build something long-term. Someone who sees an opportunity to grow a business, take ownership of its success, and be rewarded for the results.



If you're excited about building something successful and growing your own earning potential along the way, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Remote Growth Marketer — Airport Car Rental Company
description:
We're Carzi, a contactless car rental company at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport running about 600 reservations a month. Most of our bookings come through Priceline and Expedia today, and we want more of them coming to us directly. We're hiring one person to own that growth, with a real ad budget, full creative control, and a commission on every direct booking you generate. We don't need an order taker. We need someone who brings us the data and tells us where to spend.



What you'll own



 • Paid acquisition: plan, build, and manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns targeting travelers flying into Phoenix, with cost per booking as your scorecard.

 • Social: run our TikTok and Instagram, including producing the short-form video and graphic creatives yourself.

 • Lifecycle
: own our Klaviyo account, build automated flows (welcome, pre-arrival, post-rental review, win-back), and run monthly campaigns off our customer data.

 • On-the-ground and in-car marketing: work with the owner and lot team on in-car inserts, QR codes, signage, referral offers, and shuttle messaging, all with trackable codes or landing pages.

 • Customer experience: review our booking flow, pre-trip messaging, and post-rental touchpoints as a customer would; read our reviews and support messages for patterns; and bring fixes that reduce friction, raise review scores, and turn first-time renters into repeat customers.

 • Reviews and reputation: build a systematic Google review program and manage responses.

 • Attribution and reporting: a monthly one-page report showing spend, bookings, and cost per booking by channel, with a clear recommendation on what to scale and what to cut.



What we're looking for



 • Three or more years running paid ad accounts (Google Ads and Meta) with your own hands, and you can show us cost per conversion results from past clients.

 • Proven ability to produce creatives: short-form video, graphics, and copy.

 • Hands-on Klaviyo experience, including flows and segmentation.

 • Comfortable in spreadsheets and analytics; you track everything and think in ROI.

 • Travel, hospitality, or e-commerce background is a plus.

 • Self-directed, opinionated, and willing to tell the owner he's wrong.



Compensation



Base salary of $1000 to $1200 per month plus commission on attributed direct booking revenue

title: Web & UX Designer (Figma) - Contract
description:
About Us



We are a performance-driven digital marketing agency specializing in websites and digital marketing for home service and healthcare businesses.



We are looking for a highly creative Web & UX Designer who can turn strategy, content, and ideas into beautiful, modern websites.



This is a design role. You are not expected to be a developer.



We care deeply about visual quality. We want someone with a strong artistic eye who understands typography, spacing, imagery, composition, branding, and modern web design.



The Role



You will be responsible for taking website projects from initial direction through completed Figma designs ready for development.



Your primary responsibility is to make our websites look exceptional while ensuring they are easy to understand and designed to generate leads.



You should be comfortable taking a rough concept, sitemap, brand, or reference website and turning it into a polished design system and complete website experience.



What You'll Do



Website Design



Create website concepts, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma



Design complete desktop and mobile experiences



Create visually strong hero sections, service pages, landing pages, location pages, and conversion sections



Select and use imagery, typography, colors, icons, and visual elements effectively



Build reusable Figma components and maintain consistency throughout the website



Translate existing brands into strong digital experiences



UX & Conversion



Design websites that balance creativity with performance.



You should understand:



Visual hierarchy



User journeys



CTA placement



Content flow



Trust and credibility



Mobile-first design



Conversion-focused layouts



How users scan and interact with websites



We don't want websites that simply "look nice." They need to communicate clearly and encourage visitors to take action.



Developer Handoff



You will prepare clean, organized Figma files that developers can build from.



This includes:



Components and reusable sections



Desktop and mobile designs



Consistent spacing



Typography systems



Clear developer notes where necessary



Assets and imagery



Reviewing the developed website against your Figma designs



You do not need to develop the website yourself.



What We're Looking For



Required



Strong portfolio of modern website designs



Advanced Figma skills



Strong artistic and visual design ability



Excellent understanding of typography, spacing, composition, imagery, and color



Experience designing complete websites, not just individual landing pages



Strong desktop and mobile design skills



Understanding of UX and conversion principles



Ability to work independently and take creative ownership



Bonus



Experience designing websites for home services, trades, healthcare, or local businesses



Understanding of WordPress and how designs translate into development



CRO or landing page experience



Basic understanding of SEO



Experience creating design systems and reusable components



Experience working directly with developers



Our Design Process



1. Discovery



Review:



Client goals



Target audience



Brand



Services



Competitors



Inspiration and reference websites



2. Wireframe



Establish:



Page structure



Content hierarchy



User journey



CTA placement



Conversion flow



3. Creative Direction



Develop the visual direction including:



Typography



Colors



Imagery



UI elements



Section styles



Overall visual language



4. High-Fidelity Figma Design



Create polished desktop and mobile designs that are ready for development.



5. Developer Handoff



Organize the Figma file, components, assets, and specifications so development can begin efficiently.



6. Design QA



Review the developed website and identify differences between the approved design and final build.



The Type of Designer We Want



We are not looking for someone who primarily builds WordPress websites using templates.



We are looking for a designer first.



You should be someone who notices when:



Typography feels wrong



Spacing is inconsistent



A hero section lacks impact



Imagery doesn't fit the brand



A page feels generic



Visual hierarchy is weak



We want someone who can look at an average website and immediately see how to make it substantially better.



Why Join Us

Significant creative freedom



Remote and flexible



Work directly with a small agency team

title: Commercial Real Estate Outreach Specialist
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Commercial Real Estate Outreach Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time, with a 30-minute break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Commercial Real Estate Outreach Specialist to support a Senior Vice President specializing in commercial real estate transactions across Southern California. The role focuses on outbound cold calling, prospecting, and relationship building with commercial property owners to identify potential sales and leasing opportunities and schedule appointments.



The ideal candidate has excellent spoken English, strong communication skills, and experience in cold calling or appointment setting. This role requires consistent daily outreach, accurate CRM management, and the ability to engage property owners professionally. Familiarity with commercial real estate research platforms such as CoStar, LoopNet, and Reonomy, along with skip-tracing tools and CRM systems, is highly desirable.



Key Responsibilities:

* Conduct daily outbound calls to commercial property owners to identify potential selling or leasing opportunities and schedule appointments for the Senior Vice President.

* Contact property owners and nearby businesses to promote new commercial property listings for sale or lease.

* Research commercial properties, ownership records, and contact information using CoStar, LoopNet, county property records, Reonomy, and skip-tracing tools.

* Maintain accurate CRM records of calls, conversations, prospect status, and follow-up activities, ensuring contact lists remain organized and up to date.

* Follow up with prospective property owners according to an established schedule to nurture leads and identify future opportunities.

* Review calling lists against applicable Do Not Call (DNC) lists and comply with relevant telemarketing regulations.

* Submit end-of-day reports summarizing call volume, conversations, prospect responses, and appointments booked.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation, strong fluency, and a natural, professional conversational style. Verbal communication skills are the top priority.

* At least one year of experience in outbound calling, cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, or appointment setting; real estate experience is preferred.

* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with business owners, handle rejection professionally, and maintain engaging conversations.

* Basic knowledge of commercial real estate terminology, including cap rates, triple-net (NNN) leases, square footage, and sales and leasing transactions, or the ability to learn quickly.

* Experience with CoStar, LoopNet, or Reonomy is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales dialers, contact databases, and skip-tracing tools.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage daily call targets and follow-up schedules independently.

* Understanding of Do Not Call (DNC) requirements and applicable outbound calling regulations.

* Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset.

* Experience supporting U.S. commercial real estate brokers or property management teams is an advantage.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.
